italian_source.official_text: Le regole del presente Codice Deontologico sono vincolanti per tutti gli iscritti all’Albo degli psicologi. Lo psicologo è tenuto alla loro conoscenza e l’ignoranza delle medesime non esime dalla responsabilità disciplinare. Le stesse regole si applicano anche nei casi in cui le prestazioni, o parti di esse, vengano effettuate a distanza, via Internet o con qualunque altro mezzo elettronico e/o telematico.

localized.editorial_title: Binding effect and scope of the Code
localized.article_text: The provisions of this Code of Professional Conduct are binding on all persons entered in the Register of Psychologists. Psychologists are required to know them, and ignorance of those provisions does not exempt them from disciplinary liability. The same provisions also apply where services, or parts of them, are provided remotely, over the Internet or by any other electronic and/or telematic means.
localized.translation_notice: Editorial translation for study purposes; the Italian text remains authoritative.
localized.core_message: Entry in the Register entails a duty to know and comply with the Code in every form of professional practice, including online practice.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Le regole del presente Codice Deontologico sono vincolanti per tutti gli iscritti all’Albo degli psicologi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The provisions of this Code of Professional Conduct are binding on all persons entered in the Register of Psychologists.
meaning_units.label: Who is bound
meaning_units.comment: The Code is not an optional set of recommendations: it binds every person entered in the Register. Its authority derives from the statutory regulation of the profession and operates alongside the general law governing professional services.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo è tenuto alla loro conoscenza
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Psychologists are required to know them
meaning_units.label: Duty to know the Code
meaning_units.comment: Knowledge of the Code is a basic professional competence. It must be kept current because the text, related legislation and disciplinary procedures may change.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e l’ignoranza delle medesime non esime dalla responsabilità disciplinare.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and ignorance of those provisions does not exempt them from disciplinary liability.
meaning_units.label: Ignorance is no defence
meaning_units.comment: A psychologist cannot avoid liability merely by saying that they did not know a rule. The alleged facts must still be established and the safeguards of the disciplinary process must be observed.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Le stesse regole si applicano anche nei casi in cui le prestazioni, o parti di esse, vengano effettuate a distanza, via Internet o con qualunque altro mezzo elettronico e/o telematico.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The same provisions also apply where services, or parts of them, are provided remotely, over the Internet or by any other electronic and/or telematic means.
meaning_units.label: Remote services
meaning_units.comment: Video calls, platforms, email, messaging and other digital tools do not create an unregulated space. Competence, consent, confidentiality, the quality of the professional relationship and sound data handling must be adapted to the medium, but none of those duties disappears.

in_practice: Check the current version of the Code and any legislation to which it refers.
Apply the same professional principles to services delivered wholly or partly online.
Assess risks specific to the digital channel, including identity, confidentiality, emergencies and continuity of service.
frequent_mistakes: Assuming that the Code applies only to face-to-face clinical work.
Using digital procedures without adapting the information provided, security arrangements and emergency planning.
Confusing lack of knowledge with lack of responsibility.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist begins consultations through a personal social-media account without verifying the service user’s identity or explaining the limits of the channel, and claims that the Code does not apply to chat messages.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Article 1 expressly applies the Code to remote practice. A full assessment would also require the specific articles on information, professional secrecy, record-keeping and competence.

legal_connections.reference: Legge n. 56/1989, art. 28, comma 6, lettera c)
legal_connections.relevance: It assigns the National Council responsibility for drawing up the Code, which is binding on every person entered in the Register.

flashcards.front: Who is bound by the Code of Professional Conduct?
flashcards.back: Every person entered in the Register of Psychologists.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: vincolanti per tutti gli iscritti all’Albo

flashcards.front: Does the Code cease to apply when a service is provided only by video call?
flashcards.back: No. Article 1 expressly extends the same provisions to remote and telematic services.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: Le stesse regole si applicano anche ... a distanza

flashcards.front: Does not knowing a rule remove disciplinary liability?
flashcards.back: No. Ignorance is no defence, although the facts and liability must still be established through the disciplinary process.

flashcards.front: Which article links the duty to know the Code with the duty to maintain professional competence?
flashcards.back: Article 5, on professional preparation, continuing development and the limits of competence.

italian_source.official_text: L’inosservanza dei precetti stabiliti nel presente Codice deontologico, ed ogni azione od omissione comunque contrarie al decoro, alla dignità ed al corretto esercizio della professione, sono punite secondo quanto previsto dall’art. 26, comma 1°, della Legge 18 febbraio 1989, n. 56, secondo le procedure stabilite dal Regolamento disciplinare.

localized.editorial_title: Professional misconduct and disciplinary sanctions
localized.article_text: Failure to comply with the requirements laid down in this Code of Professional Conduct, and any act or omission otherwise contrary to professional propriety, professional dignity or the proper practice of the profession, shall be sanctioned as provided by Article 26(1) of Law no. 56 of 18 February 1989, in accordance with the procedures laid down in the Disciplinary Regulations.
localized.translation_notice: Editorial translation for study purposes; the Italian text remains authoritative.
localized.core_message: Disciplinary liability may arise from breach of a specific requirement or from an act or omission incompatible with professional propriety, dignity and proper practice.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: L’inosservanza dei precetti stabiliti nel presente Codice deontologico
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Failure to comply with the requirements laid down in this Code of Professional Conduct
meaning_units.label: Breach of a specific requirement
meaning_units.comment: Conduct may be challenged because it conflicts with one or more articles of the Code. The allegation must identify the relevant facts and give the registrant a proper opportunity to respond.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: ed ogni azione od omissione comunque contrarie al decoro, alla dignità ed al corretto esercizio della professione
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and any act or omission otherwise contrary to professional propriety, professional dignity or the proper practice of the profession
meaning_units.label: General clause
meaning_units.comment: The article also covers acts and omissions that undermine the profession’s essential values even when they do not correspond exactly to a highly specific rule. This broad wording does not permit automatic findings: its application must be reasoned in the circumstances of the particular case.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: sono punite secondo quanto previsto dall’art. 26, comma 1°, della Legge 18 febbraio 1989, n. 56
meaning_units.localized_fragment: shall be sanctioned as provided by Article 26(1) of Law no. 56 of 18 February 1989
meaning_units.label: Range of sanctions
meaning_units.comment: Depending on the seriousness of the conduct, the statute provides for a warning, reprimand, suspension from professional practice for up to one year, or removal from the Register. Article 2 does not assign a fixed sanction to each type of breach.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: secondo le procedure stabilite dal Regolamento disciplinare.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: in accordance with the procedures laid down in the Disciplinary Regulations.
meaning_units.label: A disciplinary process is required
meaning_units.comment: A complaint is not a finding of guilt. The applicable procedure, clear notice of the allegation, the right to present a defence, fact-finding and a reasoned decision are all required. Disciplinary regulations may differ territorially, so the competent rules must be identified.

in_practice: Consider both what the psychologist did and what they failed to do.
Do not infer the sanction from the article number alone: seriousness, established facts and procedure all matter.
Distinguish between a complaint, the opening of proceedings, the decision and any subsequent appeal.
frequent_mistakes: Treating every professional disagreement as disciplinary misconduct.
Presenting an allegation as though it were already a finding of guilt.
Forgetting that an omission may also have ethical significance.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: Following a dispute, a psychologist repeatedly sends intimidating messages to a former patient and uses information learned during the professional relationship.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The conduct could engage Article 2’s general clause and, depending on the facts, the duties concerning responsibility, dignity, professional secrecy and avoidance of harm. Only disciplinary proceedings can determine the breaches and sanction.

real_case_links.note: The Council found that threatening messages had been sent to a former patient and imposed a one-month suspension for breaches of Articles 2, 3, 4, 22 and 38. Other alleged conduct was not found proved. It is not known whether the decision was appealed.

legal_connections.relevance: It sets out the disciplinary sanctions and requires the seriousness of the conduct to be taken into account.

flashcards.front: Does Article 2 deal only with literal breaches of other articles?
flashcards.back: No. It also covers acts and omissions contrary to professional propriety, dignity and proper practice.

flashcards.front: Does a complaint to the Order itself prove misconduct?
flashcards.back: No. Liability must be established under the disciplinary procedure and with a proper right of defence.

flashcards.front: What four sanctions are specified by the statute governing the profession?
flashcards.back: Warning, reprimand, suspension for up to one year, and removal from the Register, graded according to seriousness.

flashcards.front: Why can intimidating conduct engage several articles?
flashcards.back: Because it may simultaneously undermine proper practice, social responsibility, dignity, the duty to avoid harm and, in some cases, professional secrecy.

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo considera suo dovere accrescere le conoscenze sul comportamento umano ed utilizzarle per promuovere il benessere psicologico dell’individuo, del gruppo e della comunità. In ogni ambito professionale opera per migliorare la capacità delle persone di comprendere se stessi e gli altri e di comportarsi in maniera consapevole, congrua ed efficace. Lo psicologo è consapevole della responsabilità sociale derivante dal fatto che, nell’esercizio professionale, può intervenire significativamente nella vita degli altri; pertanto deve prestare particolare attenzione ai fattori personali, sociali, organizzativi, finanziari e politici, al fine di evitare l’uso non appropriato della sua influenza, e non utilizza indebitamente la fiducia e le eventuali situazioni di dipendenza dei committenti e degli utenti destinatari della sua prestazione professionale. Lo psicologo è responsabile dei propri atti professionali e delle loro prevedibili dirette conseguenze.

localized.editorial_title: Purpose, influence and social responsibility
localized.article_text: The psychologist regards it as a duty to advance knowledge of human behaviour and to use that knowledge to promote the psychological wellbeing of individuals, groups and communities. In every area of professional practice, the psychologist works to improve people’s ability to understand themselves and others and to act in an aware, appropriate and effective manner. The psychologist is mindful of the social responsibility arising from the fact that professional practice may significantly affect the lives of others; particular attention must therefore be paid to personal, social, organisational, financial and political factors in order to avoid the improper use of professional influence. The psychologist must not improperly exploit the trust or any position of dependency of commissioning parties, service users or other recipients of professional services. The psychologist is responsible for their professional acts and their directly foreseeable consequences.
localized.translation_notice: Editorial translation for study purposes; the Italian text remains authoritative.
localized.core_message: Psychological knowledge must be used to promote wellbeing, without abusing professional influence, trust or dependency.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo considera suo dovere accrescere le conoscenze sul comportamento umano
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist regards it as a duty to advance knowledge of human behaviour
meaning_units.label: Advancing knowledge
meaning_units.comment: Professional practice requires continued study and the development of knowledge, not merely the preservation of what was learned at the outset. This principle complements the continuing-development duty in Article 5.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: ed utilizzarle per promuovere il benessere psicologico dell’individuo, del gruppo e della comunità.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and to use that knowledge to promote the psychological wellbeing of individuals, groups and communities.
meaning_units.label: Promoting wellbeing
meaning_units.comment: Professional competence is directed towards the wellbeing not only of individuals but also of groups and communities. How that purpose is pursued depends on the instruction and the professional context.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: In ogni ambito professionale opera per migliorare la capacità delle persone di comprendere se stessi e gli altri e di comportarsi in maniera consapevole, congrua ed efficace.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In every area of professional practice, the psychologist works to improve people’s ability to understand themselves and others and to act in an aware, appropriate and effective manner.
meaning_units.label: Understanding and awareness
meaning_units.comment: An intervention should support understanding, autonomy and the ability to choose, rather than passive obedience to the professional. The wording applies to every area of practice, not only psychotherapy.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo è consapevole della responsabilità sociale derivante dal fatto che, nell’esercizio professionale, può intervenire significativamente nella vita degli altri;
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist is mindful of the social responsibility arising from the fact that professional practice may significantly affect the lives of others;
meaning_units.label: Professional power
meaning_units.comment: Assessments, diagnoses, reports, selection exercises and interventions can alter significant opportunities and decisions. This imbalance calls for care even where the psychologist believes that they are acting with good intentions.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: pertanto deve prestare particolare attenzione ai fattori personali, sociali, organizzativi, finanziari e politici, al fine di evitare l’uso non appropriato della sua influenza,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: particular attention must therefore be paid to personal, social, organisational, financial and political factors in order to avoid the improper use of professional influence.
meaning_units.label: Context and influence
meaning_units.comment: Technical soundness is not assessed in a vacuum. Organisational pressure, financial interests, hierarchies, vulnerability and the wider social context may distort purposes and decisions; they must be recognised and managed.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e non utilizza indebitamente la fiducia e le eventuali situazioni di dipendenza dei committenti e degli utenti destinatari della sua prestazione professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist must not improperly exploit the trust or any position of dependency of commissioning parties, service users or other recipients of professional services.
meaning_units.label: No exploitation of trust
meaning_units.comment: Trust and functional dependency must not be exploited for personal advantage, control, pressure or a purpose outside the instruction. The commissioning party and the recipient may be different people, and both must be considered when responsibility is assessed.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo è responsabile dei propri atti professionali e delle loro prevedibili dirette conseguenze.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist is responsible for their professional acts and their directly foreseeable consequences.
meaning_units.label: Responsibility for acts and consequences
meaning_units.comment: Psychologists must anticipate the direct consequences of their decisions that can reasonably be foreseen. The provision does not make them automatically responsible for every later event: foreseeability, causation and context must be assessed on the evidence.

in_practice: Ask who may be affected by the service in addition to the immediate commissioning party.
Identify pressures, interests and imbalances that could distort professional judgement.
Anticipate the reasonably foreseeable direct effects of reports, communications and decisions.
frequent_mistakes: Using a service user’s trust to obtain personal advantage or consent that is not freely given.
Reducing responsibility to the technical correctness of a tool.
Equating wellbeing with what the professional, organisation or family wants for the recipient.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: An occupational psychologist alters an assessment to favour the candidate preferred by senior management, fails to disclose the pressure received, and knows that the report will affect other people’s careers.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: This engages the use of influence, organisational factors and responsibility for foreseeable consequences. Professional autonomy and the reliability of the conclusions would also need to be considered.

real_case_links.note: The decision concerning threatening messages to a former patient also found a breach of Article 3. The summary does not extend that finding to other conduct that the Council did not regard as proved.
The Court of Cassation upheld a suspension by reference, among other provisions, to Article 3 where a psychologist accepted a new partisan instruction after previously working with the couple.

legal_connections.relevance: It defines the scope of the profession in relation to individuals, groups, social bodies and communities.

flashcards.front: Whose wellbeing is expressly mentioned in Article 3?
flashcards.back: The wellbeing of individuals, groups and communities.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: dell’individuo, del gruppo e della comunità

flashcards.front: A commissioning party pressures a psychologist to alter an assessment. What is the first Article 3 risk?
flashcards.back: Improper use of influence within an organisational and financial context; autonomy and reliability must also be assessed.

flashcards.front: Does Article 3 make a psychologist responsible for every subsequent consequence?
flashcards.back: No. It refers to the psychologist’s professional acts and directly foreseeable consequences; causation and foreseeability must be established.

flashcards.front: Which article protects professional autonomy where outside pressure threatens judgement?
flashcards.back: Article 6. Article 7 complements it by requiring properly founded assessments and express acknowledgement of their limits.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: evitare l’uso non appropriato della sua influenza

italian_source.official_text: Nell’esercizio della professione, lo psicologo rispetta la dignità, il diritto alla riservatezza, all’autodeterminazione ed all’autonomia di coloro che si avvalgono delle sue prestazioni; ne rispetta opinioni e credenze, astenendosi dall’imporre il suo sistema di valori; non opera discriminazioni in base a religione, etnia, nazionalità, estrazione sociale, stato socio-economico, sesso di appartenenza, orientamento sessuale, disabilità. Lo psicologo utilizza metodi e tecniche salvaguardando tali principi, e rifiuta la sua collaborazione ad iniziative lesive degli stessi. Quando sorgono conflitti di interesse tra l’utente e l’istituzione presso cui lo psicologo opera, quest’ultimo deve esplicitare alle parti, con chiarezza, i termini delle proprie responsabilità ed i vincoli cui è professionalmente tenuto.In tutti i casi in cui il destinatario ed il committente dell’intervento di sostegno o di psicoterapia non coincidano, lo psicologo tutela prioritariamente il destinatario dell’intervento stesso.

localized.editorial_title: Dignity, autonomy and non-discrimination
localized.article_text: In professional practice, the psychologist respects the dignity and rights to confidentiality, self-determination and personal autonomy of those who use their services; respects their opinions and beliefs and refrains from imposing their own system of values; and does not discriminate on grounds of religion, ethnic origin, nationality, social background, socio-economic status, sex, sexual orientation or disability. The psychologist uses methods and techniques that safeguard those principles and refuses to participate in initiatives that infringe them. Where a conflict of interest arises between a service user and the organisation in which the psychologist works, the psychologist must clearly explain to the parties the scope of their responsibilities and the constraints arising from their professional duties. Whenever the recipient of a support or psychotherapy intervention is not the same person as the commissioning party, the psychologist gives priority to protecting the recipient of the intervention.
localized.translation_notice: Editorial translation for study purposes; the Italian text remains authoritative.
localized.core_message: The recipient is not a means to achieve the professional’s or organisation’s objectives: dignity, confidentiality, autonomy, personal values and equal treatment must guide every decision.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Nell’esercizio della professione, lo psicologo rispetta la dignità, il diritto alla riservatezza, all’autodeterminazione ed all’autonomia di coloro che si avvalgono delle sue prestazioni;
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In professional practice, the psychologist respects the dignity and rights to confidentiality, self-determination and personal autonomy of those who use their services;
meaning_units.label: Fundamental rights of the person
meaning_units.comment: Dignity, confidentiality, self-determination and autonomy must shape how information is provided, assessments are conducted, interventions are delivered and results are communicated. Professional confidentiality is not identical to data protection, although both may apply.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: ne rispetta opinioni e credenze, astenendosi dall’imporre il suo sistema di valori;
meaning_units.localized_fragment: respects their opinions and beliefs and refrains from imposing their own system of values;
meaning_units.label: No imposition of values
meaning_units.comment: A psychologist may explore values and consequences but must not use the professional role to convert, moralise or direct a person’s life according to the psychologist’s own preferences. Respect does not require approval of every action or abandonment of legal and professional boundaries.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: non opera discriminazioni in base a religione, etnia, nazionalità, estrazione sociale, stato socio-economico, sesso di appartenenza, orientamento sessuale, disabilità.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and does not discriminate on grounds of religion, ethnic origin, nationality, social background, socio-economic status, sex, sexual orientation or disability.
meaning_units.label: Prohibition of discrimination
meaning_units.comment: The listed characteristics must not lead to less favourable professional treatment. Differentiating an intervention is legitimate where it addresses needs, accessibility or appropriateness rather than prejudice. General law may protect additional characteristics beyond those expressly listed.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo utilizza metodi e tecniche salvaguardando tali principi, e rifiuta la sua collaborazione ad iniziative lesive degli stessi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist uses methods and techniques that safeguard those principles and refuses to participate in initiatives that infringe them.
meaning_units.label: Compatible methods and refusal to participate
meaning_units.comment: It is not enough merely to profess respect: tools, procedures and purposes must also be compatible with these principles. A psychologist should not lend professional authority to a project that infringes them.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Quando sorgono conflitti di interesse tra l’utente e l’istituzione presso cui lo psicologo opera, quest’ultimo deve esplicitare alle parti, con chiarezza, i termini delle proprie responsabilità ed i vincoli cui è professionalmente tenuto.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Where a conflict of interest arises between a service user and the organisation in which the psychologist works, the psychologist must clearly explain to the parties the scope of their responsibilities and the constraints arising from their professional duties.
meaning_units.label: Conflict between service user and organisation
meaning_units.comment: In a school, business, health service, prison or judicial setting, more than one interest may be involved. Before ambiguity causes harm, the psychologist must clarify the role, instruction, recipients of communications, limits of confidentiality and scope for professional decision-making.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: In tutti i casi in cui il destinatario ed il committente dell’intervento di sostegno o di psicoterapia non coincidano, lo psicologo tutela prioritariamente il destinatario dell’intervento stesso.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Whenever the recipient of a support or psychotherapy intervention is not the same person as the commissioning party, the psychologist gives priority to protecting the recipient of the intervention.
meaning_units.label: Priority given to the recipient
meaning_units.comment: The person who pays or gives the instruction does not automatically become the person whose interests take priority. For the support and psychotherapy interventions specified in the provision, priority must be given to protecting the person who receives the intervention.

in_practice: Clarify who is the commissioning party, who receives the service, and who will receive information or results.
Adapt language, setting and tools to ensure accessibility and respect for difference.
Refuse instructions or procedures that require discrimination, improper coercion or the imposition of values.
frequent_mistakes: Promising absolute confidentiality in an institutional setting that requires information to be shared with third parties.
Confusing respect for a person’s beliefs with a duty to share those beliefs.
Assuming that the person who pays takes priority without considering the actual recipient and type of intervention.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A company asks a psychologist to use support sessions to identify ‘disloyal’ employees and to disclose personal details. The psychologist accepts without explaining the dual role to participants and reports judgements based partly on their religious beliefs.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: This engages dignity, confidentiality, non-discrimination and the duty to clarify the conflict between the service user and the organisation. Professional secrecy, the duty to provide information and professional autonomy may also be relevant.

real_case_links.note: In the case concerning threatening messages to a former patient, the Order also found a breach of the duty to respect dignity under Article 4.

legal_connections.relevance: It provides additional safeguards where professional services involve processing personal data, which will often include special-category data.

flashcards.front: Which four core protections appear at the start of Article 4?
flashcards.back: Dignity, confidentiality, self-determination and autonomy.

flashcards.front: A commissioning organisation wants detailed results that were not explained to the service user. What does Article 4 require?
flashcards.back: The responsibilities and constraints must be clearly explained to all parties and, for the interventions specified, priority must be given to protecting the recipient.

flashcards.front: Is adapting a tool to make it accessible to a disabled person discriminatory?
flashcards.back: Not necessarily. An adjustment based on accessibility and appropriateness supports equal access; prejudice resulting in disadvantage is the concern.

flashcards.front: Which article complements the service user–organisation conflict rule by protecting technical autonomy?
flashcards.back: Article 6, which prohibits working conditions that are incompatible with professional autonomy and the Code.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: conflitti di interesse tra l’utente e l’istituzione

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo è tenuto a mantenere un livello adeguato di preparazione e aggiornamento professionale, con particolare riguardo ai settori nei quali opera. La violazione dell’obbligo di formazione continua, determina un illecito disciplinare che è sanzionato sulla base di quanto stabilito dall’ordinamento professionale. Riconosce i limiti della propria competenza e usa, pertanto solo strumenti teorico – pratici per i quali ha acquisito adeguata competenza e, ove necessario, formale autorizzazione. Lo psicologo impiega metodologie delle quali è in grado di indicare le fonti e riferimenti scientifici, e non suscita, nelle attese del cliente e/o utente, aspettative infondate.

localized.editorial_title: Competence, continuing development and scientific foundations
localized.article_text: The psychologist must maintain an adequate level of professional knowledge and continuing professional development, with particular regard to the fields in which they practise. Breach of the continuing professional development obligation constitutes disciplinary misconduct and shall be sanctioned in accordance with the rules governing the profession. The psychologist recognises the limits of their professional competence and accordingly uses only theoretical and practical tools for which they have acquired adequate competence and, where required, formal authorisation. The psychologist uses methods for which they can cite sources and scientific references and does not create unfounded expectations in clients and/or service users.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Professional qualification does not confer competence in every field: continuing development, recognised limits, properly mastered tools, scientific foundations and realistic expectations are all required.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo è tenuto a mantenere un livello adeguato di preparazione e aggiornamento professionale, con particolare riguardo ai settori nei quali opera.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist is required to maintain an adequate level of preparation and professional updating, with particular regard to the areas in which he operates.
meaning_units.label: Provision
meaning_units.comment: The update must be continuous and consistent with the activities actually carried out. Accumulation of non-relevant training does not replace the required preparation by the case and the working sector.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: La violazione dell’obbligo di formazione continua, determina un illecito disciplinare che è sanzionato sulla base di quanto stabilito dall’ordinamento professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The violation of the obligation to continue training, determines a disciplinary offence which is sanctioned on the basis of what is established by the professional order.
meaning_units.label: Continuing training
meaning_units.comment: The training obligation has disciplinary importance. Operating rules, triennials, esons and recovery modes can change: the app must return to the updated CNOP/ECM page instead of crystallizing numbers no longer in force.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Riconosce i limiti della propria competenza
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Recognizes the limits of its competence
meaning_units.label: Consciousness of limits
meaning_units.comment: Recognizing a limit means being able to postpone, seek supervision or integrate other skills when necessary. Anziatà, general title or subjective security do not demonstrate by themselves specific competence.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e usa, pertanto solo strumenti teorico – pratici per i quali ha acquisito adeguata competenza e, ove necessario, formale autorizzazione.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and therefore only theoretical tools – practical for which it has acquired adequate competence and, where necessary, formal authorization.
meaning_units.label: Instruments and authorizations
meaning_units.comment: A tool should be chosen and used only if the professional knows about the conditions, limits, administration and interpretation. When the law reserves an activity or requires a further title, the only informal experience is not enough.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo impiega metodologie delle quali è in grado di indicare le fonti e riferimenti scientifici,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist uses methods of which he can indicate scientific sources and references,
meaning_units.label: Scientific traceability
meaning_units.comment: The professional must be able to explain on what sources a methodology is based and why it is suitable for purpose. Citing science or individual author generically does not replace a critical assessment of evidence.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e non suscita, nelle attese del cliente e/o utente, aspettative infondate.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and does not arouse, in the expectations of the customer and/or user, unfounded expectations.
meaning_units.label: Lifelike expectations
meaning_units.comment: Results, times and probability should not be presented as certain when they are not. Correct communication distinguishes goals, limits and possible alternatives without promising healing or guaranteed outcomes.

in_practice: Document training, supervision and skills relevant to the service offered.
Check sources, evidence quality and instrument limits.
Send or collaborate with other professional when the need exceeds its competence.
Regularly check the ECM position on updated institutional sources.
frequent_mistakes: Use a test after a short presentation without proper training.
Presenting a controversial methodology as definitely effective.
To confuse registration to the Albo, specialization, private certification and concrete competence.

hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The case recalls relevant preparation, limits of competence, competent use of the instruments, scientific bases and unfounded expectations. The final qualification depends on actual facts and activities.

localized.editorial_title: Professional autonomy and technical responsibility
localized.article_text: The psychologist accepts only working conditions that do not compromise professional autonomy or compliance with this Code of Professional Conduct and, where those conditions are absent, informs their Order. The psychologist safeguards their autonomy in selecting and using psychological methods, techniques and instruments and is therefore responsible for their application and use, the results obtained, and the resulting assessments and interpretations. When collaborating with professionals from other disciplines, the psychologist exercises full professional autonomy while respecting the competence of others.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: A commissioning party may define the instruction but may not dictate conclusions or methods that are incompatible with competence, technical autonomy and the Code.

localized.article_text: In professional and research activities, when communicating their results, and in teaching, the psychologist carefully assesses—also in relation to the context—the validity and reliability of the information, data and sources on which conclusions are based; where appropriate, presents alternative interpretations and makes the limitations of the results explicit. localized.editorial_title: Consent and protection of research participants
localized.article_text: When conducting research, the psychologist must provide participants with adequate information in order to obtain their prior informed consent, including information about the researcher’s name, scientific and professional status and any institution to which the researcher belongs. The psychologist must also ensure that participants are entirely free to give, refuse or withdraw consent. Where the nature of the research makes it impossible to give participants full and accurate information in advance about certain aspects of the study, the psychologist must nevertheless provide the required information at the end of the test or data-collection process and obtain authorisation to use the data collected. Where participants are unable, because of age or for another reason, to give valid consent, consent must be given by the person with parental responsibility or the legal guardian and also by the participants themselves where they are able to understand the nature of the requested involvement. In every case, participants’ rights to confidentiality, non-identifiability and anonymity must be protected.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychological research requires adequate information, a free and revocable choice, enhanced protection for those unable to consent validly, and continuing protection of confidentiality.

localized.editorial_title: Professional secrecy
localized.article_text: The psychologist is strictly bound by professional secrecy. Accordingly, the psychologist does not disclose matters, facts or information learned by reason of the professional relationship, nor disclose that professional services have been provided or planned, unless one of the circumstances specified in the following articles applies.

localized.editorial_title: Giving evidence and consent to depart from professional secrecy
localized.article_text: The psychologist refrains from giving evidence about facts learned by reason of the professional relationship. The psychologist must nevertheless assess whether it is appropriate to rely on that consent, giving paramount consideration to the recipient’s psychological welfare.

localized.editorial_title: Statutory reporting duties and serious risk
localized.article_text: Where there is a statutory duty to submit a clinical report (referto) or a statutory duty to report an offence (denuncia), the psychologist, in order to protect the person’s psychological welfare, discloses no more of what was learned through the professional relationship than is strictly necessary. localized.editorial_title: Ground rules and confidentiality in group interventions
localized.article_text: Where an intervention is conducted with or through a group, the psychologist must explain at the outset the rules governing the intervention. Where necessary, the psychologist must also secure the group members’ commitment to respect each person’s right to confidentiality.

localized.editorial_title: Secure custody, retention and continuity of protection
localized.article_text: The secrecy of communications must also be protected through the secure custody and control of notes, memoranda, documents or recordings of any kind and in any form that concern the professional relationship. Such professional records must be retained for at least five years after the professional relationship ends, without prejudice to any specific legal requirements. The psychologist must arrange for that protection to be entrusted to a colleague or to the professional Order in the event of the psychologist’s death or incapacity. A psychologist involved in creating or using record-keeping systems must work to put safeguards in place for the persons concerned.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Confidentiality requires secure control of every form of professional record, retention for at least five years unless specific rules provide otherwise, continuity after death or incapacity, and systems designed to protect the people concerned.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: La segretezza delle comunicazioni deve essere protetta anche attraverso la custodia e il controllo di appunti, note, scritti o registrazioni di qualsiasi genere e sotto qualsiasi forma, che riguardino il rapporto professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The secrecy of communications must also be protected through the custody and control of notes, notes, writings or recordings of any kind and in any form, which relate to the professional relationship.
meaning_units.label: Case of each format
meaning_units.comment: The protection is for paper, files, email, chat, audio, video, agenda, backups and devices. Case and control involve authorized access, authentication, physical security, adequate channels and handling of copies and loss.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Tale documentazione deve essere conservata per almeno i cinque anni successivi alla conclusione del rapporto professionale,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: This documentation must be kept for at least five years after the conclusion of the professional relationship,
meaning_units.label: Five years as a minimum duration
meaning_units.comment: The five-year period starts from the conclusion of the report and is a minimum deontological threshold, not a cancellation order per fifth year. The closing date and the reasons for conservation must be identified.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: fatto salvo quanto previsto da norme specifiche.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: subject to the provisions of specific rules.
meaning_units.label: Prevalence of specific disciplines
meaning_units.comment: Other rules, types of documents, health contexts, probationary obligations or purposes may require different times. Keeping longer requires a basis and a justifiable duration; the rule does not authorize undefined accumulation.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo deve provvedere perché, in caso di sua morte o di suo impedimento, tale protezione sia affidata ad un collega ovvero all’Ordine professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist must provide for the protection of a colleague or professional order in the event of his death or impediment.
meaning_units.label: Continuity in case of death or impedance
meaning_units.comment: A practicable solution must be prepared before the emergency: referent, instructions, safe access and criteria to inform the interested parties. The colleague or the Order receive protection responsibility, not indiscriminate access to content.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo che collabora alla costituzione ed all’uso di sistemi di documentazione si adopera per la realizzazione di garanzie di tutela dei soggetti interessati.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist who collaborates on the establishment and use of documentation systems is working to carry out safeguards of protection of the interested parties.
meaning_units.label: Integrated protection in systems
meaning_units.comment: Those who help to choose or use folders, archives, platforms and shared systems must promote effective guarantees: access profiles, tracking, backups, encryption where appropriate, recovery and cancellation procedures, agreements with suppliers and incident response.

in_practice: Invent documents, devices, copies and backups that concern the professional relationship.
Define accesses by role, authentication, physical protection, recovery and management of accidents.
Record conclusion of the report, applicable retention rule and date of review or cancellation.
Prepare a documented plan for death or impedance, coordinated with colleague or Order.
Evaluate suppliers and systems before use and not only after a violation.
frequent_mistakes: Store clinical notes in personal accounts or shared devices without adequate protection.
Interpret the five years as a maximum term or automatic cancellation.
Keep everything indefinitely without purpose, re-examination criterion or specific norm.
Do not prepare any plan for death, prolonged illness or other impediment.
Rely on the default settings of a platform without evaluating access, backup and vendors.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist keeps registrations and nominees in a personal cloud with shared passwords in the family, without registering files, conservation policy, controlled backups or indications for a possible impediment.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The situation exposes unauthorized access and interrupts the continuity of protection. Relevant custody, control, documentation and planning systems for impedance, as well as data protection discipline.

legal_connections.relevance: Connect conservation limitation, data protection from the design and technical and organizational measures appropriate to the risk.

flashcards.front: The minimum time must be kept for the documentation according to art. 17?
flashcards.back: For at least five years after the conclusion of the vocational report, subject to specific rules.

flashcards.front: Five years have passed. Art. 17 imposes immediate cancellation?
flashcards.back: No. Fix a minimum duration; specific rules and a justifiable basis can affect further conservation.

flashcards.front: Is the case only about the formal medical records?
flashcards.back: No. It includes notes, notes, writings and recordings of any kind and form related to the relationship.

flashcards.front: What should be expected by death or impedance of the psychologist?
flashcards.back: The custody of documentation protection to a colleague or to the Professional Order.

italian_source.official_text: In ogni contesto professionale lo psicologo deve adoperarsi affinché sia il più possibile rispettata la libertà di scelta, da parte del cliente e/o del paziente, del professionista cui rivolgersi.

localized.editorial_title: Freedom to choose a professional
localized.article_text: In every professional context, the psychologist must take all reasonable steps to ensure that a client’s and/or patient’s freedom of choice as to which professional to consult is respected as fully as possible.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: So far as their role permits, psychologists protect the client’s or patient’s ability to choose freely which professional to consult.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: In ogni contesto professionale lo psicologo deve adoperarsi affinché sia il più possibile rispettata la libertà di scelta,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In every professional context, the psychologist must strive to ensure that freedom of choice is respected as much as possible,
meaning_units.label: An active duty in every context
meaning_units.comment: It is not enough to avoid an explicit ban: the psychologist must strive to reduce pressure, dependencies and unpredictable constraints. The formula 'as much as possible' recognises that organizations, availability and measures can limit, but requires the maximum practical choice.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: da parte del cliente e/o del paziente, del professionista cui rivolgersi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: by the customer and/or the patient, the professional to contact.
meaning_units.label: The choice belongs to the recipient
meaning_units.comment: Family, clients, entities or authorities may have legitimate roles, but they must not be replaced without the will of the capable adult person. Correct information, alternatives and absence of retaliation make the actual choice.

in_practice: Explain that the recipient can ask another professional and how to do it without losing documentation or continuity.
Avoid economic, affective, organizational or clinical pressures to hold the person.
In the routes indicated by authorities or authorities, clarify real margins of choice, nature of the sending and expected consequences.
Manage the switch to a colleague so as to protect confidentiality and continuity.
frequent_mistakes: Confuse the clinical recommendation with the power to impose a certain professional.
To approach with a family adult against the will of the recipient.
Obstacle transfer of relevant information when the person chooses another professional.
Promise absolute freedom without explaining real organizational or legal limits.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A patient communicates that he wants to continue with a closer partner. The psychologist insists that changing therapist would demonstrate "resistance to care" and threatens to communicate to the family that the patient does not cooperate.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Pressure and threat can compromise freedom of choice. The full evaluation would also involve self-determination, secret, non-lisivation and management of the conclusion of the report.

real_case_links.note: The Territorial Council also appealed for Article. 18: the intentions with the mother and the insistence to continue with the same therapist were considered to be detrimental, or at least dangerous, for the freedom of choice of the adult patient.

legal_connections.relevance: For health care treatments, self-determination, information, free consent, refusal and revocation; the art. 18 deontological works in every professional context.

flashcards.front: What should the psychologist be encouraged according to art. 18?
flashcards.back: The maximum possible respect of the freedom of the customer or patient to choose the professional.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: sia il più possibile rispettata la libertà di scelta

flashcards.front: An adult wants to change therapist, but a family member asks the psychologist to stop him. What is the central principle?
flashcards.back: The choice of the professional belongs to the customer or patient, unless specific legal limits to be verified.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: da parte del cliente e/o del paziente

flashcards.front: Art. 18 guarantees that every professional you want is always available?
flashcards.back: No. It requires to strive for the maximum possible respect of the choice, compatibly with real and legitimate limits.

flashcards.front: What article is the issue of the interruption of therapy and the orientation of more suitable interventions?
flashcards.back: Art. 27.

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo che presta la sua opera professionale in contesti di selezione e valutazione è tenuto a rispettare esclusivamente i criteri della specifica competenza, qualificazione o preparazione, e non avalla decisioni contrarie a tali principi.

localized.editorial_title: Professional criteria in selection and assessment
localized.article_text: A psychologist working in selection and assessment contexts must apply only criteria concerning the specific competence, qualifications or preparation required and must not endorse decisions that are contrary to those principles.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: In selection and assessment, judgements and decisions must turn on relevant competence, qualifications and preparation rather than outside pressure or unrelated criteria.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo che presta la sua opera professionale in contesti di selezione e valutazione
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist who performs his professional work in selection and evaluation contexts
meaning_units.label: High impact contexts
meaning_units.comment: The standard is for activities in which an assessment can affect work, training, access to roles or other opportunities. It is necessary to clarify the term, criteria, tools, recipients of the results and decision-making margins of the psychologist.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: è tenuto a rispettare esclusivamente i criteri della specifica competenza, qualificazione o preparazione,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: is required to comply with the criteria of specific competence, qualification or preparation,
meaning_units.label: Criteria relevant to the task
meaning_units.comment: The assessment must refer to the requirements really necessary for the stated position or purpose. Personal preferences, stereotypes, recommendations or irrelevant features cannot replace defined and applied professional criteria consistently.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e non avalla decisioni contrarie a tali principi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and do not have decisions contrary to these principles.
meaning_units.label: Prohibition of invalidity
meaning_units.comment: The psychologist should not give technical coverage to a decision already made on foreign bases. If the customer alters the ranking or uses the results for an incompatible purpose, the professional reports the problem, delimites his contribution and evaluates if he withdraws his or her own avall.

in_practice: Define prior to the assessment requirements, indicators, tools and relevant decision-making rules.
Document because each criterion is connected to the required competence, qualification or preparation.
Separate the technical result from the final organizational decision and indicate its limits.
Refuse signature or avall when the customer subverts professional criteria.
frequent_mistakes: Rearly adjust scores to favour a candidate indicated by the management.
Use personal features not relevant to the role as a proxy for fitness.
Presenting a datorial decision as a psychological conclusion.
Apply tests or thresholds without checking their relevance, validity and conditions of use.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: After a selection, the management asks to reverse the candidate with the best profile because it may require a family leave. The psychologist changes the report and signs the ranking as technically founded.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The decision is not based on the specific competence, qualification or preparation and receives an improper professional outcrop. They may also detect antidiscriminatory rules outside the Code.

flashcards.front: What criteria should selection and evaluation guide?
flashcards.back: Those of the specific competence, qualification or preparation.

flashcards.front: The client changes the ranking to promote knowledge. Can the psychologist sign it as a technical outcome?
flashcards.back: No. It must not endorse decisions contrary to the professional criteria of art. 19.

flashcards.front: Art. 19 does the psychologist always make the final decision to take?
flashcards.back: No. It may provide a technical assessment, but it must not endorse decisions contrary to the criteria set out.

flashcards.front: Which article requires data and conclusions founded and reliable?
flashcards.back: Art. 7.

italian_source.official_text: Nella sua attività di docenza, di didattica e di formazione lo psicologo stimola negli studenti, allievi e tirocinanti l’interesse per i principi deontologici, anche ispirando ad essi la propria condotta professionale.

localized.editorial_title: Professional ethics in teaching and training
localized.article_text: In teaching, educational and training activities, the psychologist encourages students, learners and trainees to take an interest in ethical principles, including by ensuring that the psychologist’s own professional conduct exemplifies those principles.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists who teach or train others do more than describe the Code: they foster ethical awareness and model it in their own professional conduct.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Nella sua attività di docenza, di didattica e di formazione
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In his teaching, teaching and training activities
meaning_units.label: All educational roles
meaning_units.comment: The duty includes lessons, workshops, supervision, mentoring and internship. It is also true when deontology is not the main topic, because methodological choices and case management still convey a professional model.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: lo psicologo stimola negli studenti, allievi e tirocinanti l’interesse per i principi deontologici,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: psychologist stimulates students, students and trainees interest in the deontological principles,
meaning_units.label: Develop deontological reasoning
meaning_units.comment: Stimulating interest means making dilemmas, responsibilities, limits and procedures visible, not asking for a simple storage. Students must learn to recognize problems and motivate careful decisions.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: anche ispirando ad essi la propria condotta professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: also inspiring them their professional conduct.
meaning_units.label: Teacher's coherence
meaning_units.comment: The trainer's behavior is part of learning. Case confidentiality, proper use of authority, respectful feedback, attribution of sources and clarity of borders must reflect the principles taught.

in_practice: To insert realistic deontological dilemmas into training activities and to discuss alternatives and consequences.
Appropriately anonymize teaching cases and declare the limits of available information.
Model respect, responsibility, competence and proper management of the currency power.
Indicate to students where to find current text, regulations and consultation procedures.
frequent_mistakes: Reduce deontology to a quiz to be stored.
Tell recognizable cases to make the lesson more engaging.
Use humiliation or favored while teaching professional respect.
Presenting personal opinions as an official interpretation of the Code.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: During the supervision, a teacher projects the folder of a patient with identifying details and liquidates questions about confidentiality saying that "in the classroom between future colleagues the Code does not count".
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The conduct contradicts both the promotion of deontological principles and the duty to inspire you in your own behavior; may be a secret, anonymity and document custody.

flashcards.front: To whom the teacher must stimulate interest in the deontological principles?
flashcards.back: Students, students and trainees.

flashcards.front: A teacher explains the Code well but uses recognizable clinical cases. Meets art. 20?
flashcards.back: No. It must also inspire its professional conduct to the deontological principles.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: ispirando ad essi la propria condotta

flashcards.front: Art. 20 is it only a specific lesson of deontology?
flashcards.back: No. The duty operates in the entire activity of teaching, teaching and training.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: Nella sua attività di docenza, di didattica e di formazione

flashcards.front: What article limits the teaching of the use of professional tools to foreign people to the profession?
flashcards.back: Art. 21.

italian_source.official_text: L’insegnamento dell’uso di strumenti e tecniche conoscitive e di intervento riservati alla professione di psicologo a persone estranee alla professione stessa costituisce violazione deontologica grave. Costituisce aggravante avallare con la propria opera professionale attività ingannevoli o abusive concorrendo all’attribuzione di qualifiche, attestati o inducendo a ritenersi autorizzati all’esercizio di attività caratteristiche dello psicologo. Sono specifici della professione di psicologo tutti gli strumenti e le tecniche conoscitive e di intervento relative a processi psichici (relazionali, emotivi, cognitivi, comportamentali) basati sull’applicazione di principi, conoscenze, modelli o costrutti psicologici. È fatto salvo l’insegnamento di tali strumenti e tecniche agli studenti dei corsi di studio universitari in psicologia e ai tirocinanti. È altresì fatto salvo l’insegnamento di conoscenze psicologiche.

localized.editorial_title: Teaching reserved psychological tools and psychological knowledge
localized.article_text: Teaching persons outside the profession to use cognitive or intervention tools and techniques reserved to the profession of psychologist constitutes serious professional misconduct. It is an aggravating factor for a psychologist, through their professional work, to endorse misleading or unlawful activities by contributing to the award of qualifications or certificates or by leading people to believe that they are authorised to carry out activities characteristic of psychologists. All cognitive and intervention tools and techniques relating to psychological processes—relational, emotional, cognitive or behavioural—and based on the application of psychological principles, knowledge, models or constructs are specific to the profession of psychologist. This does not prevent those tools and techniques from being taught to students enrolled on university psychology programmes or to trainees. Nor does it prevent the teaching of psychological knowledge.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Teaching outsiders to make operational use of reserved tools is a serious breach; teaching psychology students and trainees, and disseminating psychological knowledge, remain permitted.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: L’insegnamento dell’uso di strumenti e tecniche conoscitive e di intervento riservati alla professione di psicologo a persone estranee alla professione stessa costituisce violazione deontologica grave.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Teaching the use of cognitive instruments and techniques and intervention reserved for the profession of psychologist to foreign people in the profession itself constitutes serious deontological violation.
meaning_units.label: Prohibition on reserved operating use
meaning_units.comment: The core is the teaching of professional "knowledge" to those who are foreign to the profession, not the mere circulation of ideas. Targets, purposes, content, operationality and risk of training in fact reserved acts are assessed.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Costituisce aggravante avallare con la propria opera professionale attività ingannevoli o abusive concorrendo all’attribuzione di qualifiche, attestati o inducendo a ritenersi autorizzati all’esercizio di attività caratteristiche dello psicologo.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: It is aggravating to validate with its professional work deceptive or abusive activities by contributing to the allocation of qualifications, certificates or inducing to be considered authorized to exercise the characteristic activities of the psychologist.
meaning_units.label: Exacerbating abuse or misleading activity
meaning_units.comment: It is more serious to use role, signature or teaching to confer ambigue qualifications or to make believe that a course authorises the activity characteristics of the psychologist. Advertising, certificate, program and declared outlets must be considered together.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Sono specifici della professione di psicologo tutti gli strumenti e le tecniche conoscitive e di intervento relative a processi psichici (relazionali, emotivi, cognitivi, comportamentali) basati sull’applicazione di principi, conoscenze, modelli o costrutti psicologici.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist's profession is specific to all the tools and techniques of learning and intervention related to psychic processes (relational, emotional, cognitive, behavioral) based on the application of principles, knowledge, models or psychological constructs.
meaning_units.label: Specific instrument perimeter
meaning_units.comment: The definition looks both at the object - psychic processes - both at the psychological basis of the instrument or intervention. Commercial name, apparent simplicity or use of individual techniques do not eliminate the need to evaluate function and professional purposes.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: È fatto salvo l’insegnamento di tali strumenti e tecniche agli studenti dei corsi di studio universitari in psicologia e ai tirocinanti.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The teaching of such tools and techniques is subject to the students of university courses in psychology and interns.
meaning_units.label: Exception for vocational training
meaning_units.comment: Students of university courses in psychology and trainees can learn tools and techniques in the appropriate training path. This is not the case of authorizing its own use before the requirements are met.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: È altresì fatto salvo l’insegnamento di conoscenze psicologiche.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The teaching of psychological knowledge is also subject to the exception.
meaning_units.label: Freedom to spread knowledge
meaning_units.comment: Principles, models and psychological knowledge can also be taught to other professionals or to the public. The practical distinction is between psychological culture useful to its role and training to exercise reserved activities of the psychologist.

in_practice: Define recipients, prerequisites and learning outcomes before designing the course.
Separate transferable knowledge from operational procedures that presuppose psychological professional competence.
Check that titles, certificates and advertising do not suggest any non-existent licenses.
Watch exercises, supervision and protected or reserved materials, clarifying the limits of use.
frequent_mistakes: To believe that every psychology teaching to non-psychologists is forbidden.
Rename a confidential technique to present it as a general competence.
Release a certificate of ambiguous title that seems to enable diagnosis or treatment.
Confuse frequency of a course and professional skill.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist organizes for anyone a short course on administration, scoring and diagnostic interpretation of psychological tests and releases the certificate of "certified clinical assessor", advertising it as enough to work with clients.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The course transfers operating use of instruments reserved to strangers and the certificate may lead to the acceptance of the psychologist's characteristic activities, integrating the aggravating profile.

real_case_links.note: The Court ruled that the transparent participation in a technical debate and the expression of a scientific opinion favourable to the norm of counseling were in itself unlawful: not every cultural opening is equivalent to teaching instruments reserved or to invalidizing abuse.

legal_connections.relevance: It defines the profession of psychologist and the exercise of psychotherapeutic activity, forming part of the framework of protected professional activities.

It punishes the abusive exercise of professions that require special skill and provides for an aggravated case for the professional who determines or directs abusive activity; the criminal judgment remains distinct from the disciplinary one.

flashcards.front: What does the Code qualify as a serious deontological violation?
flashcards.back: Teach people outside the profession the use of tools and techniques reserved to the psychologist.

flashcards.front: A teacher course explains motivation principles without training to diagnosis. Is it automatically forbidden?
flashcards.back: No. The teaching of psychological knowledge is expressly done without prejudice to; it is necessary to evaluate its actual content and purposes.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: fatto salvo l’insegnamento di conoscenze psicologiche

flashcards.front: A frequency certificate that is enabled for the autonomous use of reserved psychological instruments?
flashcards.back: No. Frequency and certification do not replace legal and professional requirements.

flashcards.front: What article does it impose to counter and report abuse?
flashcards.back: Art. 8; the criminal court is relevant. 348 c.p.

italian_source.chapter: Capo II - Rapporti con l'utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo adotta condotte non lesive per le persone di cui si occupa professionalmente, e non utilizza il proprio ruolo ed i propri strumenti professionali per assicurare a sè o ad altri indebiti vantaggi.

localized.editorial_title: Avoidance of harm and prohibition of improper benefit
localized.article_text: The psychologist acts in ways that avoid harm to the people with whom they work professionally and does not use the professional role or professional tools to secure an improper benefit for themselves or another person.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists must avoid harmful conduct and must not exploit their role or professional tools to obtain an improper benefit for themselves or anyone else.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo adotta condotte non lesive per le persone di cui si occupa professionalmente,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist adopts non-lexive conduct for the people he works in professionally,
meaning_units.label: Non-liberties
meaning_units.comment: The duty is to make decisions, communications, omissions and report management. It does not promise the absence of any discomfort - some interventions can be challenging - but requires not to inflict avoidable damage and to assess predictable risks and protective measures.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e non utilizza il proprio ruolo ed i propri strumenti professionali per assicurare a sè o ad altri indebiti vantaggi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and does not use its role and professional tools to ensure its own or other undue benefits.
meaning_units.label: No exploitation of the role
meaning_units.comment: Information, authority, dependence and professional techniques cannot be used for money not due, favors, control, retaliation or benefits to third parties. The point is not the existence of any advantage, but its undue character and the connection with the use of the role.

in_practice: Evaluate predictable risks and alternatives less harmful before and during the operation.
Recognize asymmetries of power, dependence and vulnerabilities in the relationship.
Separate the interest of the person from economic, relational or organizational advantages of the professional and third parties.
Break and correct timely practices become lesive or instrumental.
frequent_mistakes: Thinking that a good intention excludes the lexivity of conduct.
Use clinical information to obtain collaboration, money or silence.
Needlessly extend the relationship for economic interest.
To encourage the customer to harm the recipient because he pays the service.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist threatens to enter in the company report irrelevant clinical details if the employee does not agree to privately purchase an additional path at his study.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The role and professional information are used to exercise pressure and obtain a potentially undue economic advantage, with possible prejudice to the person.

real_case_links.note: The territorial council considered the repeated sending of threatening messages to a former patient and applied a one-month suspension, recalling also art. 22; other disputed conducts were not fully tested.

flashcards.front: What two fundamental prohibitions contains art. 22?
flashcards.back: Adopt lesive conduct and use role or professional tools to provide undue benefits.

flashcards.front: The psychologist only prolongs an ineffective therapy to continue cashing. What profile does it look like?
flashcards.back: Possible use of the role for an undue advantage, in addition to the duties of art. 27 on the absence of benefit.

flashcards.front: Any discomfort caused by an intervention proves a violation of art. 22?
flashcards.back: No. It is necessary to distinguish a proportionate discomfort and explained by a professionally harmful conduct or avoidable harm.

flashcards.front: What article does the mixes between professional role and private life regulate?
flashcards.back: Art. 28.

italian_source.chapter: Capo II - Rapporti con l'utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo pattuisce nella fase iniziale del rapporto quanto attiene al compenso professionale. In ogni caso la misura del compenso deve essere adeguata all’importanza dell’opera. In ambito clinico tale compenso non può essere condizionato all’esito o ai risultati dell’intervento professionale.

localized.editorial_title: Agreement and amount of the professional fee
localized.article_text: At the beginning of the professional relationship, the psychologist agrees the professional fee. In every case, the amount of the fee must be commensurate with the importance of the work. In a clinical context, the fee must not be contingent on the outcome or results of the professional intervention.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: The fee is agreed at the outset, must be commensurate with the importance of the work and, in clinical practice, must not depend on the result of the intervention.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo pattuisce nella fase iniziale del rapporto quanto attiene al compenso professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist suffers in the initial phase of the report as regards professional compensation.
meaning_units.label: Initial economic agreement
meaning_units.comment: Before the report is advanced, it must be understandable tariff, including benefits, expenses, absences, reports, meetings with third parties and modification conditions. The regulations on regulated professions also require a maximum written or digital quote and other information to the customer.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: In ogni caso la misura del compenso deve essere adeguata all’importanza dell’opera.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In any case, the measure of compensation must be adapted to the importance of the work.
meaning_units.label: Adjustment of compensation
meaning_units.comment: The amount must be reasonably linked to nature, complexity, responsibility, time and activity required. There is no fixed tariff in the text, but the agreement cannot become arbitrary or matte.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: In ambito clinico tale compenso non può essere condizionato all’esito o ai risultati dell’intervento professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In the clinical field, this compensation cannot be conditioned on the outcome or results of professional intervention.
meaning_units.label: Prohibition of compensation at result in clinic
meaning_units.comment: Payment may not depend on healing, improvement, diagnosis or other clinical outcome. The ban protects independence, realism of expectations and freedom to interrupt or change an ineffective intervention.

in_practice: Deliver a written or digital quote at first with essential cost items and conditions.
Explain separately interview, test, relationships, meetings and external activities when relevant.
Clearly agree with absences, delays, variations and performance that are not foreseeable.
Avoid bonuses, returns or increased clinical outcome.
frequent_mistakes: Communicate the cost only after the first performance.
Obmitting predictable expenses for testing, relationships or dating with third parties.
Promise refund or request an economic award based on clinical improvement.
Confuse absence of mandatory tariffs with freedom from transparency and agreement.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: After five sessions, the psychologist informs the patient that each relationship and telephone contact will be invoiced at a rate never indicated; It also proposes an economic reward if symptoms decrease within three months.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The initial plea and cost transparency are missing, while the award links the compensation to the clinical result in contrast to the last period of the article.

legal_connections.relevance: It requires that the compensation be granted to the assignment and made known compulsory in writing or digital form by means of a maximum quote, with cost items and other information provided.
