italian_source.chapter: Capo II - Rapporti con l'utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo, nella fase iniziale del rapporto professionale, fornisce all’individuo, al gruppo, all’istituzione o alla comunità, siano essi utenti o committenti, informazioni adeguate e comprensibili circa le sue prestazioni, le finalità e le modalità delle stesse, nonché circa il grado e i limiti giuridici della riservatezza. Pertanto, opera in modo che chi ne ha diritto possa esprimere un consenso informato. Se la prestazione professionale ha carattere di continuità nel tempo, dovrà esserne indicata, ove possibile, la prevedibile durata.

localized.editorial_title: Information at the outset and informed consent
localized.article_text: At the beginning of the professional relationship, the psychologist provides the individual, group, organisation or community—whether service users or commissioning parties—with adequate and comprehensible information about the services, their purposes and how they will be provided, and about the extent and legal limits of confidentiality. The psychologist therefore works in such a way that the person entitled to do so can give informed consent. Where professional services are to continue over time, their anticipated duration must be stated wherever possible.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: At the outset, psychologists explain the service, its purpose, method and confidentiality to service users and commissioning parties in comprehensible terms so that the person legally entitled to consent can make an informed choice.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo, nella fase iniziale del rapporto professionale, fornisce all’individuo, al gruppo, all’istituzione o alla comunità, siano essi utenti o committenti, informazioni adeguate e comprensibili
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist, at the initial stage of the professional relationship, provides the individual, the group, the institution or the community, whether they are users or clients, adequate and understandable information
meaning_units.label: Information for all recipients and roles
meaning_units.comment: User and customer may coincide or be different subjects. The psychologist must clarify to each one what is relevant to his role, using language and tools suitable for the ability, language, context and conditions of the person.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: circa le sue prestazioni, le finalità e le modalità delle stesse, nonché circa il grado e i limiti giuridici della riservatezza.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: about its performance, its purpose and its methods, and about the degree and legal limits of confidentiality.
meaning_units.label: Essential information content
meaning_units.comment: The nature of the activity, objectives, method, roles, predictable use of results and confidentiality boundaries should be explained. In third party mandates it is particularly important to clarify who will receive what information and for what purpose.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Pertanto, opera in modo che chi ne ha diritto possa esprimere un consenso informato.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Therefore, it operates so that those entitled to it may express an informed consent.
meaning_units.label: Consent of the legitimated person
meaning_units.comment: Consent is a process based on information and choice possibilities, not a mechanically collected signature. It is necessary to identify those who have the right to express it; specific rules apply to health, minors, incapable persons or authority measures.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Se la prestazione professionale ha carattere di continuità nel tempo, dovrà esserne indicata, ove possibile, la prevedibile durata.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: If the professional performance is a continuity in time, it must be indicated, where possible, the foreseeable duration.
meaning_units.label: Predictable duration
meaning_units.comment: When the route is continuous, a realistic estimate is communicated or at least the review criteria. "Where possible" avoids false promises, but does not justify silence when a reasonable forecast can be offered and updated.

in_practice: Identifying the recipient of the performance, contractor, payer and recipient of the results.
Explain purposes, methods, roles, possible uses of information and legal limits of confidentiality.
Adapt information to the person and verify understanding and freedom of decision.
Document information and consent in consistent manner with the applicable specific provisions.
Update consent and estimate of duration when changing mandate, purpose or conditions.
frequent_mistakes: Use a standard module without dialogue or understanding verification.
Confuse consent to the provision and privacy consent as if they were a single act.
Do not explain to the assessor that the results will be communicated to the customer.
Promise absolute secret without indicating legal limits.
Obmitting any indication of the duration of a continuous journey while offering an estimate.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A company sends an employee to an evaluation. The psychologist collects a generic signature, does not explain that the report will be delivered to the management or what data will contain and initiate interviews presented as confidential support.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Information does not clarify nature, purpose, mode and limits of confidentiality; consent is therefore likely not to be really informed. Artts are also relevant. 19 and 25.

legal_connections.relevance: For health care treatments, information, free consent, refusal, revocation and documentation; the art. 24 of the Code applies more widely to the professional relationship and must be coordinated with it.
Data processing requires a legal basis and transparent information; privacy consent does not automatically coincide with the consent to the professional performance.

flashcards.front: Are consent to the provision and consent to the processing of data always the same consent?

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo non usa impropriamente gli strumenti di diagnosi e di valutazione di cui dispone. localized.editorial_title: Use of assessment instruments and communication of results
localized.article_text: The psychologist does not misuse the available diagnostic and assessment instruments. Where an intervention is commissioned by a third party, the psychologist informs the persons concerned about the nature of the professional intervention and does not use information learned that may prejudice them except within the scope of the instruction received. When communicating the results of diagnostic and assessment interventions, the psychologist must regulate that communication with due regard also to the persons’ psychological welfare.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Assessment instruments must be used properly; under a third-party instruction, people must be informed and potentially prejudicial information must remain within the instruction; results must be communicated with regard to psychological welfare.

meaning_units.label: Psychologically protective return

Prepare a return that is understandable and proportionate to the possible reaction of the person.

Let a person believe that he is evaluated on behalf of third parties that everything will remain therapeutically reserved.
Delivering the client with over-the-counter clinical data compared to the application.

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo si astiene dall’intraprendere o dal proseguire qualsiasi attività professionale ove propri problemi o conflitti personali, interferendo con l’efficacia delle sue prestazioni, le rendano inadeguate o dannose alle persone cui sono rivolte. Lo psicologo evita, inoltre, di assumere ruoli professionali e di compiere interventi nei confronti dell’utenza, anche su richiesta dell’Autorità Giudiziaria, qualora la natura di precedenti rapporti possa comprometterne la credibilità e l’efficacia.

localized.editorial_title: Refraining where personal issues or previous relationships interfere
localized.article_text: The psychologist refrains from undertaking or continuing any professional activity where the psychologist’s own personal problems or conflicts interfere with the effectiveness of the service and make it inadequate or harmful to the people for whom it is intended. The psychologist also avoids assuming a professional role or carrying out interventions with service users, including at the request of a Judicial Authority, where the nature of a previous relationship could compromise the credibility or effectiveness of the work.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists do not begin or continue work made inadequate or harmful by personal issues, and do not take on roles that a previous relationship would render ineffective or lacking in credibility.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo si astiene dall’intraprendere o dal proseguire qualsiasi attività professionale ove propri problemi o conflitti personali, interferendo con l’efficacia delle sue prestazioni, le rendano inadeguate o dannose alle persone cui sono rivolte.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist refrains from engaging in or continuing any professional activity where his or her personal problems or conflicts, interfering with the effectiveness of his/her performance, make them inadequate or harmful to the people who are addressed.
meaning_units.label: Relevant personal interference
meaning_units.comment: Not every personal difficulty automatically imposes abstention. The threshold is interference that compromises effectiveness and makes performance inadequate or harmful. Self-assessment, supervision, reduction of the load, sending or suspension may be necessary.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo evita, inoltre, di assumere ruoli professionali e di compiere interventi nei confronti dell’utenza, anche su richiesta dell’Autorità Giudiziaria,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist also avoids taking professional roles and making interventions towards users, even at the request of the Judiciary Authority,
meaning_units.label: The mandate of the authority does not erase incompatibility
meaning_units.comment: A judicial request does not automatically make the assignment appropriate. Before accepting, prior reports, confidential knowledge, interests and role overlaps must be declared and evaluated.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: qualora la natura di precedenti rapporti possa comprometterne la credibilità e l’efficacia.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: if the nature of previous reports can compromise its credibility and effectiveness.
meaning_units.label: Previous reports and compromise
meaning_units.comment: It is not enough that a previous contact existed: they count nature, intensity, information acquired, position of the parties and new task. Prevention already works when credibility or effectiveness can be compromised, without waiting for damage.

in_practice: Make a control of previous conflicts and reports before accepting any new mandate.
Monitoring during the report if personal conditions are reducing competence, judgment or reliability.
Use supervision or consultation without transferring unduly identifying data.
To promptly declare incompatibility to the subject or competent authority and to facilitate a safe passage.
frequent_mistakes: Accepting why the judicial authority has requested the intervention, without reporting the previous report.
Consider only economic conflicts relevant, not affective, personal or informative conflicts.
Wait for the damage to be manifested instead of assessing the risk of compromise.
Continue during a personal invalidating condition without supervision, reduction of the load or sending.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: After a couple, the psychologist agrees to draw a part-relation against each other for one of the two, using information learned in the joint sessions and without declaring the previous report.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The nature of the previous report can jeopardize the credibility and effectiveness of the new role; secret, responsibility and protection of both former recipients are also involved.

real_case_links.note: The Cassation confirmed the suspension of one month in a case of previous treatment of the couple followed by an assignment in the exclusive interest of one former patient in conflict with the other; the artts were recalled. 3, 11 and 26.

flashcards.front: When do personal problems or conflicts impose abstention?
flashcards.back: When, interfering with effectiveness, they make performance inadequate or harmful.

flashcards.front: The judicial authority proposes an assignment on a person already followed. Can you accept it automatically?
flashcards.back: No. It should be assessed whether the previous report could compromise credibility and effectiveness.

flashcards.front: Does any previous contact make a new assignment incompatible?
flashcards.back: Not automatically: they detect the nature of the relationship and the possibility of compromising credibility or effectiveness.

flashcards.front: What article more directly governs the secret of the information of the previous report?

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo valuta ed eventualmente propone l’interruzione del rapporto terapeutico quando constata che il paziente non trae alcun beneficio dalla cura e non è ragionevolmente prevedibile che ne trarrà dal proseguimento della cura stessa. Se richiesto, fornisce al paziente le informazioni necessarie a ricercare altri e più adatti interventi.

localized.editorial_title: Ending therapy where it provides no benefit
localized.article_text: The psychologist considers and, where appropriate, proposes ending the therapeutic relationship when it is clear that the patient derives no benefit from the treatment and it is not reasonably foreseeable that continuing the treatment will provide any benefit. If requested, the psychologist gives the patient the information needed to seek other, more appropriate interventions.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Where therapy provides no benefit and none can reasonably be expected from continuing, the psychologist considers ending it and, if asked, helps the patient identify more appropriate interventions.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo valuta ed eventualmente propone l’interruzione del rapporto terapeutico quando constata che il paziente non trae alcun beneficio dalla cura
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist evaluates and possibly proposes the interruption of the therapeutic relationship when he finds that the patient does not benefit from the treatment
meaning_units.label: Evaluate the absence of benefit
meaning_units.comment: The effectiveness should be reviewed with clinical data, agreed goals and patient point of view. "Eventually proposes" requires dialogue and professional judgment: it does not authorize a sudden abandonment or obliges to interrupt after a single difficulty.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e non è ragionevolmente prevedibile che ne trarrà dal proseguimento della cura stessa.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and it is not reasonably predictable that it will be carried out by the continuation of the care itself.
meaning_units.label: Prognosis on the continuation
meaning_units.comment: It is not enough that the benefit is not yet visible: it is necessary to assess whether it is reasonable to predict it by changing times, methods, objectives or conditions. Inertial continuation is not justified when a clinical perspective is missing.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Se richiesto, fornisce al paziente le informazioni necessarie a ricercare altri e più adatti interventi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: If required, it provides the patient with the information needed to search for other and more suitable interventions.
meaning_units.label: Guide to alternatives
meaning_units.comment: On request, the psychologist offers useful information to find suitable alternatives, without imposing a single colleague or guaranteeing results. In vulnerable or urgent cases, the management of the transition must consider security and welfare continuity.

in_practice: periodically review goals, trends, adherence, obstacles and patient preferences.
Discuss possible changes before concluding that the continuation will not bring benefit.
Motivate and document the proposal for interruption, agreeing time and closing management.
If required, indicate types of intervention, services or criteria to choose suitable alternatives.
Manage risk and continuity when an immediate closure could be harmful.
frequent_mistakes: Continue indefinitely without reevaluating effectiveness and objectives.
Abruptly interrupts for personal frustration or lack of payment without managing clinical risks.
Confuse a difficult phase with a definitive test of ineffectiveness.
Presenting one colleague as the only alternative, compressing the freedom of choice.
Promise that the new intervention will certainly produce results.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: For many months the psychologist noted that therapy does not produce any benefit and that the method is not suitable, but continues without discussing it because he fears to lose the compensation. When the patient asks for alternatives, he responds that he has to arrange.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The continuation without reasonable forecast of benefit and refusal to provide, on request, information for other interventions directly recall art. 27 and may involve non-lisitiveness and undue advantage.

legal_connections.relevance: In health care treatments, the consent, refusal and revocation of the treatment report is valued; the professional proposal of interruption must be coordinated with the self-determination of the patient.

flashcards.front: What two conditions do they assess the interruption?
flashcards.back: No current benefit and no reasonable benefit forecast from continuation.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: non trae alcun beneficio ... non è ragionevolmente prevedibile

flashcards.front: The patient does not improve in early sessions. Art. 27 immediately imposes an arrest?
flashcards.back: No. It requires an assessment of the performance and reasonable forecast of benefit, not a temporal automatism.

flashcards.front: Proposing the interruption is the same as abandoning the patient?
flashcards.back: No. It is a dialogue decision; information should be provided on request to seek more suitable interventions and the transition should be managed prudently.

flashcards.front: What article protects the freedom to choose the new professional?
flashcards.back: Art. 18.

italian_source.chapter: Capo II – Rapporti con l’utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo evita commistioni tra il ruolo professionale e vita privata che possano interferire con l’attività professionale o comunque arrecare nocumento all’immagine sociale della professione. Costituisce grave violazione deontologica effettuare interventi diagnostici, di sostegno psicologico o di psicoterapia rivolti a persone con le quali ha intrattenuto o intrattiene relazioni significative di natura personale, in particolare di natura affettivo-sentimentale e/o sessuale. Parimenti costituisce grave violazione deontologica instaurare le suddette relazioni nel corso del rapporto professionale. Allo psicologo è vietata qualsiasi attività che, in ragione del rapporto professionale, possa produrre per lui indebiti vantaggi diretti o indiretti di carattere patrimoniale o non patrimoniale, ad esclusione del compenso pattuito. Lo psicologo non sfrutta la posizione professionale che assume nei confronti di colleghi in supervisione e di tirocinanti, per fini estranei al rapporto professionale.

localized.editorial_title: Boundaries between the professional role and personal relationships
localized.article_text: The psychologist avoids any mixing of the professional role and private life that could interfere with professional activity or otherwise harm the public standing of the profession. Providing diagnostic, psychological support or psychotherapy interventions to a person with whom the psychologist has or has had a significant personal relationship—particularly an emotional, romantic and/or sexual relationship—constitutes serious professional misconduct. Establishing such a relationship during the professional relationship likewise constitutes serious professional misconduct. The psychologist is prohibited from any activity that, by reason of the professional relationship, may produce a direct or indirect improper benefit, whether financial or non-financial, other than the agreed professional fee. The psychologist does not exploit the professional position held in relation to colleagues under supervision or trainees for purposes outside the professional relationship.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists maintain clear boundaries: they avoid compromising overlaps with private life, do not establish improper significant relationships, obtain no improper benefit, and do not exploit supervisees, colleagues or trainees.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo evita commistioni tra il ruolo professionale e vita privata che possano interferire con l’attività professionale o comunque arrecare nocumento all’immagine sociale della professione.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist avoids mixes between the professional role and private life that can interfere with professional activity or in any case harm the social image of the profession.
meaning_units.label: Preventing harmful commits
meaning_units.comment: The norm does not prohibit any social contact, but requires to prevent overlaps capable of altering judgment, freedom, confidentiality or trust, or to harm the social image of the profession. They count the context, the asymmetry of power and the predictable effects, even after the formal conclusion of the relationship.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Costituisce grave violazione deontologica effettuare interventi diagnostici, di sostegno psicologico o di psicoterapia rivolti a persone con le quali ha intrattenuto o intrattiene relazioni significative di natura personale, in particolare di natura affettivo-sentimentale e/o sessuale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: It is a serious violation of deontological conducting diagnostic, psychological support or psychotherapy aimed at people with whom it has entertained or entertains significant relationships of a personal nature, in particular affective-sentimental and/or sexual nature.
meaning_units.label: Interests on people linked by significant relationships
meaning_units.comment: For diagnosis, psychological support and psychotherapy, the text qualifies as a serious violation when the recipient is or has been linked to the psychologist by a meaningful personal relationship, especially affective, sentimental or sexual. It is not enough to rename the intervention or to declare itself impartial: the conflict arises from the structure of the relationship.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Parimenti costituisce grave violazione deontologica instaurare le suddette relazioni nel corso del rapporto professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Similarly, it is a serious violation of the deontological nature of the relationship between the two parties.
meaning_units.label: No significant relationship during the report
meaning_units.comment: Initiating a significant personal relationship of the type described above is in turn qualified as a serious violation. The consent of the person does not eliminate asymmetry, dependence or possible use of information and influence arising from the role.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Allo psicologo è vietata qualsiasi attività che, in ragione del rapporto professionale, possa produrre per lui indebiti vantaggi diretti o indiretti di carattere patrimoniale o non patrimoniale, ad esclusione del compenso pattuito.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Any activity which, due to the professional relationship, may produce undue direct or indirect benefits of a patrimonial or non- Asset character, for him, is prohibited, except for the benefit he has paid.
meaning_units.label: No undue advantages
meaning_units.comment: The only ordinary economic advantage allowed by the text is the agreed compensation. There are also problematic advantages indirect or non-capitalist — favors, accesses, visibility, performance or opportunity — when they are improperly derived from the professional relationship.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo non sfrutta la posizione professionale che assume nei confronti di colleghi in supervisione e di tirocinanti, per fini estranei al rapporto professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist does not exploit the professional position he assumes with regard to colleagues in supervision and trainees, for purposes outside the professional relationship.
meaning_units.label: Protecting entities and trainees
meaning_units.comment: The power to evaluate, certify, guide or influence the path of others cannot be used to obtain favors, relationships, free work or other foreign purposes. The rule applies even if the request is presented as optional, when addiction makes it difficult to refuse.

in_practice: Evaluate any personal, economic, family or hierarchy before the assignment and document the decision.
It is a matter of caution and sending to another professional when an incompatible mix emerges.
Do not transform data, trust or dependence acquired in the relationship into personal opportunities.
In supervision and internships, clearly separate evaluation, training and personal requests.
frequent_mistakes: To believe that the consent of the person makes a sexual-affective relationship that began during therapy.
Think that the formal end of the report immediately cancels any imbalance or residual risk.
Consider only the cash benefits undue.
Ask for private favors to an intern counting on his own currency influence.

hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The establishment of the report during the report is qualified by the text as a serious violation; free and consent do not eliminate asymmetry. They can also detect non-lisitivities, dignity and management of the conclusion.

real_case_links.note: In the proceedings, an alleged sexual-affective relationship was also challenged, but the Council did not fully consider it to be proved and did not take part in Art. 28. The case teaches not to transform an attachment into a proven fact; the penalty concerned other conduct.

flashcards.front: What relationships make it serious to diagnose, support or psychotherapy on the same person?
flashcards.back: Significant personal relationships, present or pre-trial, in particular affective-sentimental or sexual.

flashcards.front: Is a sexual relationship that started during therapy acceptable if the patient says he wants it?
flashcards.back: No. The text identifies the establishment of this report during the report as a serious violation.

flashcards.front: Art. 28 does not only prohibit undue economic advantages?
flashcards.back: No. It includes direct or indirect benefits, assets or non-fundamental benefits.

italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo può subordinare il proprio intervento alla condizione che il paziente si serva di determinati presidi, istituti o luoghi di cura soltanto per fondati motivi di natura scientifico-professionale.

localized.editorial_title: Making an intervention conditional on using a particular facility
localized.article_text: The psychologist may make an intervention conditional on the patient using specified services, institutions or treatment facilities only where there are sound scientific and professional reasons for doing so.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: A psychologist may require a patient to use a particular treatment facility only for sound scientific and professional reasons, never for convenience or personal interest.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo può subordinare il proprio intervento alla condizione che il paziente si serva di determinati presidi, istituti o luoghi di cura
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist may subordinate his intervention to the condition that the patient uses certain presidi, institutes or places of care
meaning_units.label: An exceptional and specific condition
meaning_units.comment: The standard is a real condition for the performance: not a simple information or proposal, but the bond to use a specific garrison, institute or place of care. A similar bond limits the patient's choice and therefore requires a robust justification.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: soltanto per fondati motivi di natura scientifico-professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: only for fundamental reasons of a scientific-professional nature.
meaning_units.label: Only scientific and professional reasons
meaning_units.comment: The reason for this is that the procedure is appropriate, security, continuity or technical conditions necessary for the intervention. Economic convenience, business agreements, personal habits or relationships with the structure do not meet the criterion. It is prudent to express and document reasons and alternatives.

in_practice: Please clarify whether the structure is necessary or only recommended.
Motivate the bond with relevant requirements of quality, safety or integration of the intervention.
Declare any economic or professional interests and manage the conflict.
Evaluate equivalent alternatives that respect freedom of choice and continuity.
frequent_mistakes: Enter a clinic because it corresponds to a commission or sends customers.
Presenting an organizational preference as a scientific necessity.
Do not explain why a structure is indispensable.
Confidence the reasoned indication with the obligation to guarantee a result.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: The psychologist agrees to follow a person only if he will carry out all the tests at a clinic of which he is a member, while being available equivalent structures, and does not communicate his economic interest.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The bond seems to be based on the interest of the professional and not on scientific and professional reasons. They can take advantage of freedom of choice, transparency and undue advantage.

flashcards.front: When can a specific care structure be set?
flashcards.back: Only for fundamental reasons of a scientific-professional nature.

flashcards.front: The psychologist imposes a clinic because he recognizes a percentage. Art. 29 does it allow?
flashcards.back: No. Economic interest is not a fundamental scientific-professional reason.

flashcards.front: Does a service always mean that you are subjecting the procedure?
flashcards.back: No. Subordinating means placing the use of that service as a condition of its performance.

flashcards.front: Which article protects the choice of the professional by the customer or patient?
flashcards.back: Art. 18.

italian_source.chapter: Capo II – Rapporti con l’utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Nell’esercizio della sua professione allo psicologo è vietata qualsiasi forma di compenso che non costituisca il corrispettivo di prestazioni professionali.

localized.editorial_title: Fees as consideration for professional services
localized.article_text: In professional practice, the psychologist is prohibited from receiving any form of fee that is not consideration for professional services.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Within the professional relationship, a psychologist may receive payment only as consideration for professional services, not for favours, introductions or unrelated advantages.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Nell’esercizio della sua professione allo psicologo è vietata qualsiasi forma di compenso
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In the exercise of his profession to the psychologist is prohibited any form of compensation
meaning_units.label: A wide ban on forms of compensation
meaning_units.comment: The word "any" prevents bypassing the rule by changing form to payment: money, goods, services or utilities can take charge. However, it is necessary to distinguish the compensation from a symbolic gesture by evaluating nature, value, moment, culture and possible influence on the relationship.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: che non costituisca il corrispettivo di prestazioni professionali.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: which does not constitute the professional performance consideration.
meaning_units.label: Must match a performance
meaning_units.comment: The transfer must pay real, transparent and lawful professional activity. Payments to send patients, direct decisions, conceal information or use the role in behalf of third parties do not become lawful because described in invoice with a generic name.

in_practice: Connect compensation and refunds to real performance or professional costs and clearly described.
Refuse commissions for incompatible sendings, reports or procacciation.
Evaluate gifts or significant value utility with caution and document the decision.
Coordinate the rule with agreed compensation, estimate and possible undue advantages.
frequent_mistakes: Accept a percentage for each patient sent to a service.
Confuse the accounting name of the payment with its real function.
Say that every little symbolic gift is automatically forbidden compensation.
Accept expensive goods in exchange for favourable decisions.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A structure offers the psychologist a luxury holiday for each group of five patients sent. The professional accepts and presents the usefulness as "honour among colleagues".
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The utility is connected to the sendings, not to the consideration of a professional performance rendered to the structure. They can also detect conflict of interests, freedom of choice and undue advantage.

flashcards.front: What is the compensation to?
flashcards.back: Professional performance.

flashcards.front: Is it lawful to receive money for each patient sent to a clinic?
flashcards.back: Not according to art. 30, if the payment pays the sending and not a real professional performance.

flashcards.front: Art. 30 automatically declares any symbolic gift unlawful?
flashcards.back: Do not use the word gift: it is necessary to understand whether the utility works as compensation or undue advantage in the concrete case.

flashcards.front: What article does patrol and measure professional compensation?
flashcards.back: Art. 23.

italian_source.chapter: Capo II – Rapporti con l’utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Le prestazioni professionali a persone minorenni o interdette sono, generalmente, subordinate al consenso di chi esercita sulle medesime la potestà genitoriale o la tutela. Lo psicologo che, in assenza del consenso di cui al precedente comma, giudichi necessario l’intervento professionale nonché l’assoluta riservatezza dello stesso, è tenuto ad informare l’Autorità Tutoria dell’instaurarsi della relazione professionale. Sono fatti salvi i casi in cui tali prestazioni avvengano su ordine dell’autorità legalmente competente o in strutture legislativamente preposte.

localized.editorial_title: Services for minors and persons under guardianship
localized.article_text: Professional services for minors or persons declared legally incapable are generally conditional on the consent of the person exercising parental responsibility or guardianship. Where, in the absence of that consent, the psychologist considers both the professional intervention and its absolute confidentiality to be necessary, the psychologist must inform the Guardianship Authority that the professional relationship has begun. This is without prejudice to cases in which those services are provided by order of an authority with legal competence or within facilities designated by legislation.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: For minors or persons under guardianship, the psychologist identifies who may consent, involves the person according to their capacity and maturity, and handles necessity, confidentiality and orders of an authority with particular care.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Le prestazioni professionali a persone minorenni o interdette sono, generalmente, subordinate al consenso di chi esercita sulle medesime la potestà genitoriale o la tutela.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Professional benefits to minors or interdept persons are generally subject to the consent of those who exercise parental power or protection on the same grounds.
meaning_units.label: General rule on consent
meaning_units.comment: The official text retains terms that are dated today: in current law, parental responsibility is spoken and the discipline of capacity is more articulated. In general, it is necessary to identify actual owners and powers, to read any measures and, for health decisions of greater interest, to consider joint exercise unless otherwise applicable. The consent of the representative does not cancel the listening, information and will of the minor person in relation to age and maturity.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo che, in assenza del consenso di cui al precedente comma, giudichi necessario l’intervento professionale nonché l’assoluta riservatezza dello stesso, è tenuto ad informare l’Autorità Tutoria dell’instaurarsi della relazione professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist who, in the absence of the consent referred to in the previous paragraph, judges necessary professional intervention and the absolute confidentiality of the same, is obliged to inform the Tutoria Authority of the establishment of the professional relationship.
meaning_units.label: Necessities, confidentiality and competent authority
meaning_units.comment: The passage requires the absence of consent, the judgment of necessity of intervention and the need for absolute confidentiality. The formula "Tutorial Authority" must be reconceived to the authority currently competent in the concrete case. The communication alone must not be presented as an automatic authorization to proceed: the recipient, form, urgency and powers require specific legal verification.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Sono fatti salvi i casi in cui tali prestazioni avvengano su ordine dell’autorità legalmente competente o in strutture legislativamente preposte.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Where such benefits are provided by the competent authority or by legislative facilities.
meaning_units.label: Order of authority or structure provided for by law
meaning_units.comment: When the performance comes from a legally competent authority order or takes place in a structure to which the law attributes that task, the framework does not coincide with the general rule of the first period. We need to read exactly mandate and standard: this does not automatically cancel information, listening, confidentiality, relevance and limitations of communication.

in_practice: Identify those who exercise parental responsibility or protection and acquire relevant measures.
Explain to the underage person, in a understandable way, purpose, mode, recipients and limits of confidentiality.
Consider will, age, maturity and condition of the person without reducing it to the object of the consent of others.
In case of disagreement, urgency or request for secrecy, avoid automatism and obtain timely deontological and legal advice.
Document consent, dissent, information, assessment of need and basis of any intervention.
frequent_mistakes: Rely on the declaration of one parent without checking the responsibility, measures and nature of the decision.
Continue after an express opposition without clarifying the legal basis.
Ignore the will of the minor because the representative has signed.
Treat information to authority as an automatic permit.
To assume that an institutional assignment eliminates all duty of information and confidentiality.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: During a conflict separation, the psychologist initiates the evaluation of a girl at the request of a parent, does not verify the measure on the exercise of responsibility, continues after the formal opposition of the other and rediges relations intended for the cause.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The conduct exposes to a violation of the general rule on consent and also requires verification of mandate, reliability of data, communication of results and possible prejudice. Family conflict makes it particularly important to listen to the minor and to distinguish care, assessment and judicial use.

real_case_links.note: The Territorial Council appealed censorship for art. 31: benefits on the underage person without the consent of a parent, continuation after the distrust and drafting of two reports.

The censorship was about the artt. 7, 31 and 39: In addition to the consent not acquired by both parents, the acritical use of information and the presentation of the professional role were evaluated.

legal_connections.relevance: For health treatments, it requires understandable information and enhancement of the will of the underage or incapable person; disciplines who expresses consent or rejection in different situations of capacity.
Parental responsibility is exercised according to current rules; decisions of greater interest in health are normally taken by common accord, except for specific measures or disciplines.

flashcards.front: What is the general rule for performance to underage people?
flashcards.back: I am generally subordinate to the consent of those who exercise parental responsibility, verifying powers and concrete situation.

flashcards.front: A parent formally opposes the child's assessment. Can we continue because the other has signed?
flashcards.back: Not automatically: liability, measures, nature of the performance, legal basis and will of the minor must be verified.

flashcards.front: Does the Information Authority always mean to receive authorization?
flashcards.back: No. The text imposes information in specific conditions; competent authority, procedure and legal effect must be verified.

flashcards.front: What article does the general rule rule on informed consent to psychological performance?
flashcards.back: Art. 24.

italian_source.chapter: Capo II – Rapporti con l’utenza e con la committenza
italian_source.official_text: Quando lo psicologo acconsente a fornire una prestazione professionale su richiesta di un committente diverso dal destinatario della prestazione stessa, è tenuto a chiarire con le parti in causa la natura e le finalità dell’intervento.

localized.editorial_title: Instruction from a commissioning party other than the recipient
localized.article_text: Where a psychologist agrees to provide professional services at the request of a commissioning party who is not the recipient of the services, the psychologist must clarify the nature and purpose of the intervention with all parties concerned.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Where the person requesting the service is not the person receiving it, the psychologist clarifies the nature and purpose of the intervention with everyone concerned before beginning the work.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Quando lo psicologo acconsente a fornire una prestazione professionale su richiesta di un committente diverso dal destinatario della prestazione stessa,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: When the psychologist agrees to provide a professional performance at the request of a client other than the recipient of the performance,
meaning_units.label: Recognising the relationship to three or more parts
meaning_units.comment: Employer, school, judge, insurance or family may ask and sometimes pay a benefit for another person. The psychologist must distinguish at least a client, recipient, payer, assessed person and recipient of the results: these roles do not automatically coincide.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: è tenuto a chiarire con le parti in causa la natura e le finalità dell’intervento.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: the nature and purpose of the intervention must be clarified with the parties concerned.
meaning_units.label: Shared clarification on nature and purpose
meaning_units.comment: All parties must know whether they are support, selection, evaluation, advice or expertise and for what purpose. They must also be clarified, according to the relevant articles, recipients of information, confidentiality limits, use of results and processing of data.

in_practice: Mapping in writing roles, demands, purpose, targets of results and decision makers.
Use understandable words and verify that the customer and recipient have the same representation as the intervention.
Explain before the collection of data what will be communicated and to whom.
Renegotiating or rejecting the mandate if the client changes its purpose in an incompatible manner.
frequent_mistakes: Tell the employee that will receive support when the real mandate is an assessment of suitability.
Let the payer automatically decide which data to receive.
Use the same general information for clinical, selective and forensic purposes.
Clarify everything only with the client.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A company presents some interviews as a space for the employees. The psychologist knows that the direction wants to classify who is "resisting of change" and sends nominative evaluations without clarifying this purpose.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Nature and purpose have not been clarified with the recipient. They may comply with informed consent, use of information, communication of results and data protection.

legal_connections.relevance: Purpose, transparency and information on data processing must be defined in accordance with the actual privacy role; the deontological clarification does not replace the legal basis.

flashcards.front: What should the psychologist clarify when the client and the recipient be different?
flashcards.back: The nature and purpose of the intervention, with the parties concerned.

flashcards.front: The company pays: can you automatically receive all the interview notes?
flashcards.back: No. Payment does not decide for its own purposes, recipients, confidentiality or lawfulness of communication.

flashcards.front: Just clarify the warrant to whom do you commission it?
flashcards.back: No. Art. 32 requires that it be clarified with the parties concerned.

flashcards.front: What article does the client request for evaluations and communication of results?
flashcards.back: Art. 25.

italian_source.chapter: Capo III – Rapporti con i colleghi
italian_source.official_text: I rapporti fra gli psicologi devono ispirarsi al principio del rispetto reciproco, della lealtà e della colleganza. Lo psicologo appoggia e sostiene i Colleghi che, nell’ambito della propria attività, quale che sia la natura del loro rapporto di lavoro e la loro posizione gerarchica, vedano compromessa la loro autonomia ed il rispetto delle norme deontologiche.

localized.editorial_title: Respect, loyalty and support among colleagues
localized.article_text: Relationships between psychologists must be guided by mutual respect, loyalty and professional collegiality. A psychologist supports colleagues whose autonomy or ability to comply with ethical requirements is compromised in the course of their work, whatever the nature of their employment relationship or their position in the organisational hierarchy.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Relationships between psychologists are founded on respect, loyalty and collegiality; where a colleague is pressured to compromise autonomy or ethics, other psychologists must provide professional support.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: I rapporti fra gli psicologi devono ispirarsi al principio del rispetto reciproco, della lealtà e della colleganza.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Relations between psychologists must be inspired by the principle of mutual respect, loyalty and co-operation.
meaning_units.label: Three criteria for professional relationships
meaning_units.comment: Respect, loyalty and co-worker ask for correct comparison, unmoved information and recognition of roles. Connectivity does not mean conformity, personal favor or silence on incorrect conduct: dissent can be firm, documented and respectful.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo appoggia e sostiene i Colleghi che, nell’ambito della propria attività, quale che sia la natura del loro rapporto di lavoro e la loro posizione gerarchica, vedano compromessa la loro autonomia ed il rispetto delle norme deontologiche.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist supports and supports the Colleghi, who, in the context of their activity, what is the nature of their working relationship and their hierarchical position, see their autonomy and respect for the deontological norms compromise.
meaning_units.label: Supporting autonomy and deontology
meaning_units.comment: Duty does not depend on contract, seniority or hierarchy. Support may consist of documenting pressure, offering comparison, involving appropriate managers or facilitating an opinion of the Order. It does not require to automatically endorse the version of the colleague or to violate confidentiality or procedures.

in_practice: Deal with dissent on data and methods without personal attacks.
Help the colleague to distinguish organizational pressure, technical divergence and illicit demand.
Keep track of pressures that can compromise autonomy or deontological norms.
Use appropriate professional and orderly channels when the problem persists.
frequent_mistakes: Exchange the link by obligation to cover an error.
Insulate a precarious colleague who refuses to alter a result.
Use the hierarchy to impose a non-data-supported conclusion.
Turn a technical dissent into personal discredit.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: The manager orders a young psychologist to change an unfavourable assessment to a manager. Other psychologists know about pressure, invite you to "do not create problems" and exclude you from meetings when you refuse.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Autonomy and compliance with the rules are compromised in a hierarchical relationship; the lack of support and isolation are contrary to the function of linkage described by art. 33.

flashcards.front: What principles inspire relationships between psychologists?
flashcards.back: Respect for each other, loyalty and co-worker.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: rispetto reciproco, della lealtà e della colleganza

flashcards.front: An intern hired undergoes pressure to ignore the Code. Does the low position eliminate the duty of support?
flashcards.back: No. Nature of the work relationship and hierarchical position do not exclude duty.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: quale che sia ... la loro posizione gerarchica

flashcards.front: Does it mean that a colleague never signals the conduct of a colleague?
flashcards.back: No. It means to relate with respect and loyalty; the art. 36 may impose the order's communication.

flashcards.front: What article protects autonomy in professional choices?
flashcards.back: Art. 6.

italian_source.chapter: Capo III – Rapporti con i colleghi
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo si impegna a contribuire allo sviluppo delle discipline psicologiche e a comunicare i progressi delle sue conoscenze e delle sue tecniche alla comunità professionale, anche al fine di favorirne la diffusione per scopi di benessere umano e sociale.

localized.editorial_title: Developing and sharing psychological knowledge
localized.article_text: The psychologist undertakes to contribute to the development of the psychological disciplines and to communicate advances in knowledge and techniques to the professional community, including in order to promote their dissemination for the purposes of human and social wellbeing.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists contribute to the development of psychology and share advances in knowledge and techniques with the professional community, directing their dissemination towards human and social wellbeing.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo si impegna a contribuire allo sviluppo delle discipline psicologiche
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist is committed to contributing to the development of psychological disciplines
meaning_units.label: Contribute to the development of discipline
meaning_units.comment: The contribution may take different forms: research, evaluation of results, training, supervision, scientific comparison or improvement of services. It does not require any professional to publish, but it implies a responsible attitude towards quality, updating and growth of knowledge.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: e a comunicare i progressi delle sue conoscenze e delle sue tecniche alla comunità professionale, anche al fine di favorirne la diffusione per scopi di benessere umano e sociale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: and to communicate the progress of his knowledge and techniques to the professional community, also in order to promote its dissemination for human and social well-being purposes.
meaning_units.label: Communicating for well-being
meaning_units.comment: Sharing progress does not mean promoting as certain techniques still uncertain. The communication must indicate evidence, limits, conditions of use and necessary skills, respecting confidentiality, intellectual property and scientific integrity. The stated purpose is human and social well-being, not only personal visibility.

in_practice: Share methods and outcomes with accuracy, declaring limits and uncertainties.
Participate in continuous training, comparison between peers or improvement of practices and services.
Protect data and identity when cases or results are communicated.
Avoid sensational promises on new or proprietary techniques.
frequent_mistakes: Presenting a personal impression as scientific progress demonstrated.
Use recognizable cases to promote a technique.
Hide unfavorable limits or results.
Confuse development of discipline with individual marketing.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist advertises as "revolutionary and scientifically certain" a technique informally experimented on a few customers, without data, limits or professional comparison, promising social benefits guaranteed.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The dissemination is not accompanied by scientifically responsible communication. The evaluation may also involve the validity of information, dignity and professional advertising.

legal_connections.relevance: The psychologist's profession also includes experimentation, research and teaching in the psychological field, as well as interventions aimed at person, group, social organisms and communities.

flashcards.front: What does the psychologist have to do with this?
flashcards.back: To the development of psychological disciplines and to the communication of progress to the professional community.

flashcards.front: A technique is new, but the evidence is preliminary. How should we be communicated?
flashcards.back: Clearly, it is clear that it is evidence, limits and uncertainties, without presenting it as a certain progress.

flashcards.front: Art. 34 imposes upon every psychologist to publish scientific articles?
flashcards.back: He doesn't say. It requires commitment to development and communication, which can be achieved in different professional forms.

flashcards.front: What article regulates the correct indication of sources in research?
flashcards.back: Art. 35.

italian_source.chapter: Capo III – Rapporti con i colleghi
italian_source.official_text: Nel presentare i risultati delle proprie ricerche, lo psicologo è tenuto ad indicare la fonte degli altrui contributi.

localized.editorial_title: Attribution of sources in research
localized.article_text: When presenting the results of research, the psychologist must identify the source of contributions made by others.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: When presenting research findings, psychologists clearly attribute ideas, data, text, methods and other contributions that belong to others.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Nel presentare i risultati delle proprie ricerche,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In submitting the results of its research,
meaning_units.label: Each form of presentation of the research
meaning_units.comment: The duty is in articles, conferences, lectures, reports, posters and public communications. Dissemination and digital material must also be made possible to distinguish the contribution from the one received or retaken.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: lo psicologo è tenuto ad indicare la fonte degli altrui contributi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: the psychologist is required to indicate the source of other contributions.
meaning_units.label: Make visible the contribution of others
meaning_units.comment: The source should be indicated in a manner appropriate to the medium and nature of the contribution. The bibliographical quotation does not solve any question: paternity, coauthority, thanksgiving, authorization to use data and plagiarism follow further criteria. The AIP Code of Ethics also considers plagiarism and self-plage and requires proportional recognition of employees.

in_practice: Cite original sources of ideas, texts, data, tools and materials.
Agree roles and criteria of authorship before publication.
Distinguish coauthors, contributors and people to thank on the basis of the real contribution.
Report explicitly previous publications of the same research.
frequent_mistakes: Copy the argumentative structure of others by quoting only an irrelevant secondary source.
Enter as author who did not contribute or exclude who had a substantial role.
Reuse the same job as new without declaring it.
To believe that a final bibliography makes every reproduction lawful.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: The group manager presents a data, analysis and graphics conference prepared by two young researchers, eliminates their names and describes everything as their own work without citing them.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The source of other contributions is not indicated. Authorization, hierarchical relationship, copyright and scientific rules would require further evaluation.

legal_connections.relevance: Copyright protects the claim of the paternity of the work; However, it does not coincide with the entire deontological duty to indicate the sources of research contributions.

flashcards.front: What should be indicated when results of research occur?
flashcards.back: The source of other people's contributions.

flashcards.front: A colleague produced substantial analysis and graphics. Can they be presented without naming it?
flashcards.back: No. Its contribution must be attributed; the correct form of recognition or authorship should also be evaluated.

flashcards.front: Does quoting a source automatically solve any copyright or authoritarian problem?
flashcards.back: No. Deontological attribute, authorization, copyright and authoritarian criteria are linked but distinct.

flashcards.front: What article promotes development and communication of knowledge to the professional community?
