italian_source.chapter: Capo III – Rapporti con i colleghi
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo si astiene dal dare pubblicamente su colleghi giudizi negativi relativi alla loro formazione, alla loro competenza ed ai risultati conseguiti a seguito di interventi professionali, o comunque giudizi lesivi del loro decoro e della loro reputazione professionale. Costituisce aggravante il fatto che tali giudizi negativi siano volti a sottrarre clientela ai colleghi. Qualora ravvisi casi di scorretta condotta professionale che possano tradursi in danno per gli utenti o per il decoro della professione, lo psicologo è tenuto a darne tempestiva comunicazione al Consiglio dell’Ordine competente.

localized.editorial_title: Public comments about colleagues and reporting to the Order
localized.article_text: The psychologist refrains from publicly expressing negative opinions about colleagues’ training, competence or the results of their professional interventions, or any opinion otherwise damaging to their professional propriety or reputation. It is an aggravating factor where such negative opinions are intended to divert clients from colleagues. Where a psychologist identifies improper professional conduct that may harm service users or the standing of the profession, the psychologist must promptly report it to the competent Council of the Order.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists avoid negative or damaging public comments about colleagues, especially for client poaching, but promptly report potentially harmful professional misconduct to the Order.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo si astiene dal dare pubblicamente su colleghi giudizi negativi relativi alla loro formazione, alla loro competenza ed ai risultati conseguiti a seguito di interventi professionali, o comunque giudizi lesivi del loro decoro e della loro reputazione professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist refrains from publicly giving negative opinions on colleagues regarding their training, their competence and the results achieved following professional interventions, or in any case legal judgments of their decor and their professional reputation.
meaning_units.label: Avoid public discredit
meaning_units.comment: The standard affects negative public judgments on the professional qualities and results and, more generally, the visual ones of decoration or reputation. It does not prevent any technical criticism: scientific comparison, assessment provided by a role, defence in judgement and institutional communication require channel, relevance, relevance, verifiable data and compliance with the applicable rules.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Costituisce aggravante il fatto che tali giudizi negativi siano volti a sottrarre clientela ai colleghi.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: It is a major factor in the fact that such negative judgments are aimed at subtracting customers from colleagues.
meaning_units.label: Subtracting customers aggravating
meaning_units.comment: The competitive aim makes conduct more serious: using discredit to acquire patients or clients adds a personal interest to the professional offense. The purpose must be assessed on the basis of facts and context, not only presumed.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Qualora ravvisi casi di scorretta condotta professionale che possano tradursi in danno per gli utenti o per il decoro della professione, lo psicologo è tenuto a darne tempestiva comunicazione al Consiglio dell’Ordine competente.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: If there are cases of incorrect professional conduct which may be brought into harm for users or for the profession, the psychologist shall be required to give it prompt notice to the Council of the competent Order.
meaning_units.label: Report to the Order promptly
meaning_units.comment: The colleague does not justify silence. When incorrect professional conduct can damage users or profession decoration, the channel provided is the Council of the competent Order and communication must be timely. It is necessary to report facts and sources with precision, to protect unnecessary data and to distinguish observations from inferences.

in_practice: Do not use social, press or promotional communications to discredit colleagues.
Formulate any technical criticism in relevant channels, with facts, limits and measured language.
When the conditions are met, send a detailed report to the Order of the Order without undue delay.
Limit personal data and clinical material to what is necessary and legitimately communicated.
frequent_mistakes: Publish charges to attract the co-worker's customers.
Use art. 36 to ban any scientific comparison or any testimony due.
Report generic conclusions without distinguishing facts, sources and hypotheses.
Call for linkage to not communicate a potentially harmful conduct.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A public psychologist video in which he defines a "uncapable and dangerous" colleague, invites his patients to move from him and, while claiming to know malicious facts, he does not send any circumstantial signal to the Order.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The public judgment is lawful and appears to be directed to subtract customers, aggravating circumstance. If there are potentially harmful misconduct, the Code indicates prompt communication to the Order, not the process on social media.

flashcards.front: What public judgments on colleagues should the psychologist refrain from?
flashcards.back: From negative judgments on training, competence and results, or in any case professional design and reputation.

flashcards.front: Publish accusations to conquer co-workers' patients changes gravity?
flashcards.back: Yes. The purpose of subtracting customers is expressly a aggravating one.

flashcards.front: Does the link impose to keep silent on a conduct that can damage users?
flashcards.back: No. Art. 36 requires the prompt communication to the Council of the competent Order.

flashcards.front: What article states respect, loyalty and co-worker?
flashcards.back: Art. 33.

italian_source.chapter: Capo III – Rapporti con i colleghi
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo accetta il mandato professionale esclusivamente nei limiti delle proprie competenze. Qualora l’interesse del committente e/o del destinatario della prestazione richieda il ricorso ad altre specifiche competenze, lo psicologo propone la consulenza ovvero l’invio ad altro collega o ad altro professionista.

localized.editorial_title: Accepting instructions within the limits of competence
localized.article_text: The psychologist accepts a professional instruction only within the limits of their competence. Where the interests of the commissioning party and/or the recipient of the service require other specific expertise, the psychologist proposes consultation with, or referral to, another psychologist or other professional.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists accept only work that they can perform competently; where additional expertise is needed, they propose consultation or referral to another psychologist or professional.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo accetta il mandato professionale esclusivamente nei limiti delle proprie competenze.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist accepts the professional mandate exclusively within the limits of his own competences.
meaning_units.label: Evaluate the competence of the mandate
meaning_units.comment: The professional title does not make competent for each population, method or context. Before accepting, you must compare your application, risk, tools, experience, training, available supervision and limits of your role. A judicial or institutional mandate does not extend jurisdiction alone.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Qualora l’interesse del committente e/o del destinatario della prestazione richieda il ricorso ad altre specifiche competenze, lo psicologo propone la consulenza ovvero l’invio ad altro collega o ad altro professionista.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: If the client’s interest and/or the recipient of the service requires the use of other specific skills, the psychologist proposes advice or sending to other colleagues or other professionals.
meaning_units.label: Please consult or send when needed
meaning_units.comment: The answer is not always to give up the entire assignment: a relevant advice can be integrated or to propose a sending, provided roles and responsibilities are clear. "Other professional" includes non-psychological skills; for example diagnosis and drug management belong to the healthcare professional enabled at that field.

in_practice: Analyze required skills before accepting, not after the problem arises.
To declare to the client the limits of his own assessment and to reformulate unfounded questions.
Use counseling or supervision when it really integrates a restricted gap.
Send to other colleague or professional when the main need comes out of your field.
Document reasons, date information and continuity management.
frequent_mistakes: Accept a specialist assignment by trusting to study the subject during work.
Answer pharmacological questions as if they were psychological evaluations.
To believe that a judge's request makes every conclusion lawful.
Use a generic sending to abandon a person without orientation or continuity.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist without neuropsychological formation accepts a complex medical-legal evaluation, uses tools that he does not know and attributes symptoms to the effects of a drug, without consulting or sending to other professionals.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The mandate shall be passed by declared and practiced skills; the pharmacological component requires another professional competence. They may also detect update, validity of data and conclusions and non-lisitiveness.

real_case_links.note: The Territorial Council also appealed for Article. 37: In a relationship the professional treated the effects of a drug beyond his specific title. Qualifications were also shown.

legal_connections.relevance: Defines the scope of psychological profession; the art. 37 adds concrete verification of the skills needed for the individual mandate.

flashcards.front: What limits do you accept the mandate?
flashcards.back: Exclusively within the limits of its competences.

flashcards.front: The question requires pharmaceutical evaluations. What does the psychologist propose?
flashcards.back: Counselling or sending to the competent professional, clarifying the limit of his role.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: altro collega o ad altro professionista

flashcards.front: Does a judicial appointment automatically expand the competences of the psychologist?
flashcards.back: No. That mandate can also be accepted only within the limits of the powers possessed.

flashcards.front: Which article requires update and proper preparation?
flashcards.back: Art. 5.

italian_source.chapter: Capo III – Rapporti con i colleghi
italian_source.official_text: Nell’esercizio della propria attività professionale e nelle circostanze in cui rappresenta pubblicamente la professione a qualsiasi titolo, lo psicologo è tenuto ad uniformare la propria condotta ai principi del decoro e della dignità professionale.

localized.editorial_title: Professional propriety and dignity
localized.article_text: When carrying out professional activities and whenever publicly representing the profession in any capacity, the psychologist must ensure that their conduct conforms to the principles of professional propriety and professional dignity.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: When practising or publicly representing the profession, psychologists maintain conduct consistent with professional propriety and dignity, assessed in context and by its effect on public trust.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Nell’esercizio della propria attività professionale e nelle circostanze in cui rappresenta pubblicamente la professione a qualsiasi titolo,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In the exercise of his professional activity and in the circumstances in which he publicly represents the profession in any way,
meaning_units.label: Two areas of application
meaning_units.comment: The norm operates during professional activity and when the psychologist publicly represents the profession, even without performing at that time a performance. A conference, interview, professional profile or social intervention can be part of the second area. However, not every act of private life is automatically attracted by art. 38: They have connection to the role, recognisability and context.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: lo psicologo è tenuto ad uniformare la propria condotta ai principi del decoro e della dignità professionale.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: the psychologist is required to uniform his conduct to the principles of professional dignity and decor.
meaning_units.label: Consistent conduct with decoration and dignity
meaning_units.comment: Decor and dignity are open criteria, to be applied with motivation and proportionality, not simple rules of style or conformity. They detect seriousness, fairness, respect for people, scientific reliability and protection of confidence in the profession. An informal tone alone does not necessarily prove a violation.

in_practice: Before a public communication, clarify whether it is spoken in a personal or professional way without using the formula as a deceptive screen.
Evaluate recipients, means, stay and possibility of reshaping content.
Separate scientific disclosure, personal experience and professional promotion.
Avoid humiliation, threats, banalizations and messages incompatible with the trust required by the role.
frequent_mistakes: Believe that the Code does not work during an interview because it is not a clinical session.
Treat every informal language as an automatic violation.
Writing 'personal opinion' while presenting itself with title and study to obtain professional authoritativeness.
Confuse professional dignity with corporate defense from legitimate criticisms.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: In a video broadcast from the study profile, a psychologist ridicules people with panic attacks, discloses basic perennial advice and uses his own title to accredit them.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Communication takes place in a condition of public representation of the profession and can affect decoration, dignity and trust. The full assessment would also involve respect, validity of information, professional presentation and advertising.

real_case_links.note: The Territorial Council appealed for warnings for articles. 38 and 40: promotional email sent to undetermined recipients, language considered trivializing and web content without adequate scientific basis.
The suspension also concerned art. 38 for threatening messages sent to a former patient; violations of the Articles of Law were also ascertained. 2, 3, 4 and 22.

flashcards.front: In which two situations the art. 38?
flashcards.back: In the exercise of professional activity and when you publicly represent the profession at any title.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: attività professionale ... rappresenta pubblicamente la professione

flashcards.front: A television interview as a psychologist is outside art. 38 Why is it not a performance?
flashcards.back: No. It is a condition in which the profession can be publicly represented.

flashcards.front: Any informal phrase automatically constitutes a violation of the decor?
flashcards.back: No. It is necessary to assess context, connection to the role, content and effects; informality and indecorosity do not coincide.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: principi del decoro e della dignità

flashcards.front: What article also punishes actions or omissions contrary to decoration, dignity and proper exercise?
flashcards.back: Art. 2.

italian_source.chapter: Capo IV – Rapporti con la società
italian_source.official_text: Lo psicologo presenta in modo corretto ed accurato la propria formazione, esperienza e competenza. Riconosce quale suo dovere quello di aiutare il pubblico e gli utenti a sviluppare in modo libero e consapevole giudizi, opinioni e scelte.

localized.editorial_title: Accurate professional presentation and free public choice
localized.article_text: The psychologist presents their training, experience and competence accurately and correctly. The psychologist recognises a duty to help members of the public and service users develop their judgements, opinions and choices freely and on an informed basis.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Psychologists describe their training, experience and competence accurately and communicate in ways that support, rather than manipulate, the free and informed judgement of the public and service users.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Lo psicologo presenta in modo corretto ed accurato la propria formazione, esperienza e competenza.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The psychologist presents his training, experience and expertise correctly and accurately.
meaning_units.label: Three profiles to describe exactly
meaning_units.comment: Training, experience and expertise are linked but not interchangeable. Aver attended a course does not equal to possess a legal specialization; having experience does not authorize an unexisting title; possess a title does not prove competence on any problem. Dates, entities, completed or ongoing status and limits must avoid misunderstandings.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Riconosce quale suo dovere quello di aiutare il pubblico e gli utenti a sviluppare in modo libero e consapevole giudizi, opinioni e scelte.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: He acknowledges his duty to help the public and users develop freely and consciously judgments, opinions and choices.
meaning_units.label: Inform without manipulating
meaning_units.comment: Professional communication must increase the ability to understand and choose. Emotional pressure, fear, false urgency, guaranteed promises, omission of limits or ambiguous use of scientific authorities can reduce freedom. The duty is also to be shared, directed and public, not only commercial advertising.

in_practice: Use titles in the exact and verifiable form, indicating the entity that released them when it serves to avoid misunderstandings.
Distinguish clearly completed training, ongoing training, experience and work area.
Describe expected benefits along with relevant limits, alternatives and uncertainties.
Correct profiles, header cards and platforms promptly when titles or roles change.
frequent_mistakes: Present yourself as a psychotherapist before the ability and annotation planned.
Calling «master» a private course so that it looks like a university master.
Explaining yourself expert based on a short experience not described.
Use general fear or diagnosis to push the public to book.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A psychologist still in training presents himself on the site as "psychotherapist and international specialist", he fails that the course is not concluded and states that those who do not book immediately risk permanent damage.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: Titles and training status are presented in a potentially inaccurate way, while false urgency hinders a free and conscious choice. They may also detect the use of title, competence and advertising.

real_case_links.note: The Council referred to art. 39 for deceptive or non-conform words, including the use of psychotherapist before the relevant inscription. Prosciolse instead from art. 40 For the purpose of procacciation was not proven.
The complaints included art. 39 for a letter of letters that ambiguously presented the university role; Artts were also ascertained. 7 and 31.

legal_connections.relevance: Distinguish sections of the Albo and professional titles; psychotherapist activity is noted in the Albo when the preconditions of law are recurred.

flashcards.front: What three aspects should be presented correctly and accurately?
flashcards.back: Training, experience and expertise.

flashcards.front: Can one write "psychotherapist" while the specialization is still in progress?
flashcards.back: No, if the title is not yet legitimately owned and annotated: the presentation would be inaccurate or deceptive.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: presenta in modo corretto ed accurato

flashcards.front: Does a training title automatically demonstrate competence in any case?
flashcards.back: No. Training, experience and expertise are distinct profiles to describe accurately.

flashcards.front: Which article sets specific criteria for advertising?
flashcards.back: Art. 40.

italian_source.chapter: Capo IV – Rapporti con la società
italian_source.official_text: Indipendentemente dai limiti posti dalla vigente legislazione in materia di pubblicità, lo psicologo non assume pubblicamente comportamenti scorretti finalizzati al procacciamento della clientela. In ogni caso, può essere svolta pubblicità informativa circa i titoli e le specializzazioni professionali, le caratteristiche del servizio offerto, nonché il prezzo e i costi complessivi delle prestazioni secondo criteri di trasparenza e veridicità del messaggio il cui rispetto è verificato dai competenti Consigli dell’Ordine. Il messaggio deve essere formulato nel rispetto del decoro professionale, conformemente ai criteri di serietà scientifica ed alla tutela dell’immagine della professione. La mancanza di trasparenza e veridicità del messaggio pubblicizzato costituisce violazione deontologica.

localized.editorial_title: Transparent, truthful and scientifically responsible advertising
localized.article_text: Irrespective of the limits imposed by the legislation in force on advertising, the psychologist does not engage in improper public conduct aimed at soliciting clients. Informational advertising may in all cases be provided about professional titles and specialisms, the characteristics of the service offered, and the price and total cost of services, provided that the message meets standards of transparency and truthfulness, compliance with which is monitored by the competent Councils of the Order. The message must respect professional propriety, meet standards of scientific responsibility and protect the standing of the profession. An advertised message that lacks transparency and truthfulness constitutes professional misconduct.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: Professional advertising is permitted, but improper client solicitation is not: titles, services and costs must be transparent and truthful and presented with professional propriety and scientific responsibility.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Indipendentemente dai limiti posti dalla vigente legislazione in materia di pubblicità, lo psicologo non assume pubblicamente comportamenti scorretti finalizzati al procacciamento della clientela.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: Regardless of the limits imposed by current advertising legislation, the psychologist does not publicly assume incorrect behaviours aimed at procacing customers.
meaning_units.label: Self-processing prohibition
meaning_units.comment: Even what the general legislation allows can remain deontologically incorrect for purposes and methods. The first case requires both incorrect public conduct and finalization to obtain customers: the intent should not be taken for granted, but rebuilt by content and context.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: In ogni caso, può essere svolta pubblicità informativa circa i titoli e le specializzazioni professionali, le caratteristiche del servizio offerto, nonché il prezzo e i costi complessivi delle prestazioni
meaning_units.localized_fragment: In any case, information about professional qualifications and specializations may be made, the characteristics of the service offered, as well as the overall price and cost of the performance
meaning_units.label: What can be advertised
meaning_units.comment: The Code provides information on actual titles and specializations, service features and overall price or costs. Advertising is not prohibited or subject to a general budget; However, it is necessary to check the territorial rules and the rules applicable to the means and service.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: secondo criteri di trasparenza e veridicità del messaggio il cui rispetto è verificato dai competenti Consigli dell’Ordine.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: according to criteria of transparency and truthfulness of the message, which is verified by the competent Councils of the Order.
meaning_units.label: Transparency, truth and orderly control
meaning_units.comment: The recipient must be able to understand who offers what, under what conditions and with what costs. Information literally true can remain misleading for omission, ambiguity or presentation. The Order's verification does not necessarily mean prior authorization: procedures and territorial competence must be controlled by the Order concerned.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Il messaggio deve essere formulato nel rispetto del decoro professionale, conformemente ai criteri di serietà scientifica ed alla tutela dell’immagine della professione.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The message must be formulated in accordance with the criteria of scientific seriousness and the protection of the image of the profession.
meaning_units.label: Decor and scientific seriousness
meaning_units.comment: Testimonials, slogans, educational content and promises must remain consistent with the available evidence. A disclaimer or isolated quote is not enough to make a message serious that guarantees results, banalizes disturbances or spreads potentially harmful indications.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: La mancanza di trasparenza e veridicità del messaggio pubblicizzato costituisce violazione deontologica.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The lack of transparency and veracity of the advertised message constitutes deontological violation.
meaning_units.label: Express violation
meaning_units.comment: The last period directly qualifies as a violation of the lack of transparency and veracity. This case should not be confused with that of the first period: a deceitful message may violate the article even if the specific purpose of procacciamento is not proven.

in_practice: Check titles, specializations, prices, compulsory costs and conditions before publication.
Describe services and possible results without guarantees, false urgency or misleading selection of evidence.
Make the responsible professional identifiable and distinguish the titles of members of an associate study.
Keep dated copy of the message and used scientific sources.
Check general rules, instructions of the competent Order and rules of the platform without confusing them.
frequent_mistakes: To believe that any professional advertising is prohibited.
Advertise an initial price by omitting necessary and predictable costs.
Promise certain healing or use percentages without verifiable source.
Present a title in progress as already achieved.
Automatically deduce the procacciation from the message's inaccuracy alone.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: A campaign announces "guarion guaranteed in three sessions at 49 euros", but the price does not include mandatory evaluation and testing, the success rate is invented and the professional uses a specialization not achieved.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The message lacks transparency and truthfulness, does not respect scientific seriousness and can hinder a conscious choice. Titles, costs, tests and possible procacciamento purposes must be evaluated separately.

real_case_links.note: The warning for artts. 38 and 40 concerned promotional modes considered trivializing and web articles with statements without adequate scientific and potentially harmful support. The declared gratuitousness was not deemed to be exemptive.

Although it is not possible to ascertain the misuse of titles pursuant to art. The Council, acting by the Court of First Instance, has not yet been able to take the view that the Commission has not yet adopted a decision on the matter. 40 because the purpose of the customer's procacciation requested by the contest was not proved.

legal_connections.relevance: Professional information advertising is free of any means, but information must be transparent, truthful, correct and unequivocal, deceptive or denigratory.

flashcards.front: What content can be related to information advertising?
flashcards.back: Titles and specializations, characteristics of service, price and overall performance costs.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: titoli ... servizio offerto ... prezzo e i costi complessivi

flashcards.front: An announcement indicates 50 euros but it hides mandatory costs. What criterion is missing?
flashcards.back: The transparency of the message; can also lack veracity in the representation of the total cost.

flashcards.front: Does any inaccuracy automatically prove incorrect procaccia?
flashcards.back: No. The aim of procacciamento is to be tried; The violation expressed for lack of transparency and truth remains distinct.

flashcards.front: What article imposes an accurate presentation of training, experience and expertise?
flashcards.back: Art. 39.

italian_source.official_text: È istituito presso la “Commissione Deontologia” dell’Ordine degli psicologi l’”Osservatorio permanente sul Codice Deontologico”, regolamentato con apposito atto del Consiglio Nazionale dell’Ordine, con il compito di raccogliere la giurisprudenza in materia deontologica dei Consigli regionali e provinciali dell’Ordine e ogni altro materiale utile a formulare eventuali proposte della Commissione al Consiglio Nazionale dell’Ordine, anche ai fini della revisione periodica del Codice Deontologico. Tale revisione si atterrà alle modalità previste dalla Legge 18 febbraio 1989, n. 56.

localized.editorial_title: Permanent Observatory and revision of the Code
localized.article_text: A ‘Permanent Observatory on the Code of Professional Conduct’ is established within the Order of Psychologists’ Ethics Committee and is governed by a specific measure adopted by the National Council of the Order. Its task is to collect the regional and provincial Councils’ body of decisions on professional ethics, together with any other material useful to the Committee when making proposals to the National Council of the Order, including proposals for periodic revision of the Code of Professional Conduct. Any such revision must follow the procedure laid down in Law no. 56 of 18 February 1989.
localized.translation_notice: Unofficial draft translation for study purposes. The Italian text displayed above is the controlling source.
localized.core_message: The Observatory collects decisions and other material to support interpretation and proposals for revision; amendments to the Code must follow the statutory procedure.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: È istituito presso la “Commissione Deontologia” dell’Ordine degli psicologi l’”Osservatorio permanente sul Codice Deontologico”, regolamentato con apposito atto del Consiglio Nazionale dell’Ordine,
meaning_units.localized_fragment: The permanent Observatory on the Code of Deontology is established at the “Deontology Commission” of the Order of Psychology, regulated by the National Council of the Order,
meaning_units.label: An organism at the Deontology Commission
meaning_units.comment: The Observatory is an institutional body, not a single territorial disciplinary office. The CNOP Regulation of 2026 lays down its functions in the Deontology Commission, composed of external advisers and experts, and regulates its duration and operation.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: con il compito di raccogliere la giurisprudenza in materia deontologica dei Consigli regionali e provinciali dell’Ordine e ogni altro materiale utile a formulare eventuali proposte della Commissione al Consiglio Nazionale dell’Ordine, anche ai fini della revisione periodica del Codice Deontologico.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: with the task of collecting the jurisprudence in the deontological matter of the regional and provincial councils of the Order and any other material useful to formulate any proposals from the Commission to the National Council of the Order, also for the purpose of the periodic review of the Code of Deontological.
meaning_units.label: Collect, analyze and propose
meaning_units.comment: Territorial decisions and other materials are familiar with the application problems and proposals to the CNOP. A territorial decision does not become a binding precedent for all, and a Commission proposal does not alter the Code itself. Regulation 2026 adds critical monitoring, guidelines and development of a national database.

meaning_units.italian_fragment: Tale revisione si atterrà alle modalità previste dalla Legge 18 febbraio 1989, n. 56.
meaning_units.localized_fragment: This revision will be subject to the procedures laid down in Law 18 February 1989, n. 56.
meaning_units.label: The revision follows the professional law
meaning_units.comment: Art. Article 28, paragraph 6, letter c), of Law No. 56/1989 gives the CNOP the provision and updating of the Code, binding for members, and requires approval by referendum. Study, consultation or guidelines do not match the entry into force of a new articulate.

in_practice: Distinguish collection of cases, interpretation addresses, proposal for revision, referendum and entry into force.
Use territorial decisions as contextualized materials, checking facts, date, outcome and possible appeal.
Always check on the CNOP website which text is indicated as in force.
Do not submit drafts, proposals or texts as applicable rules.
frequent_mistakes: Treat a single territorial deliberation as a binding national precedent.
To say that a proposal from the Observatory has already modified the Code.
Confondere Commission Deontologia, Osservatorio e Consiglio territorial disciplinary.
Study a review without checking its approval and effectiveness.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: The Observatory publishes a proposal for a new article. A course of preparation for the State Examination immediately inserts it between the current norms and states that the members are already sanctioned on the basis of the new text.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: The proposal does not amount to effective review. The whole procedure provided for in the law and the institutional publication of the text in force must be checked. The scenario illustrates an educational and institutional error, not an individual violation of art. 41.

legal_connections.reference: Legge n. 56/1989, art. 28, comma 6, lettera c)
legal_connections.relevance: It contributes to the CNOP preparing and updating the Code, binding for members, with approval by referendum.
It describes the composition and current functions of the Commission and the Observatory, including monitoring, guidelines, proposals and procedures databases.

flashcards.front: What does the permanent Observatory collect?
flashcards.back: The deontological jurisprudence of the territorial councils and other useful material to any proposals and revisions.
flashcards.italian_official_anchor: raccogliere la giurisprudenza ... e ogni altro materiale utile

flashcards.front: Does the Commission propose that the Code be changed immediately?

meaning_units.label: A precise term after the proclamation
meaning_units.comment: Approval, proclamation and entry into force are distinct moments. The text does not apply on the day of the vote or necessarily the day when the referendum ends, but on the 30th day after the proclamation of the results. For concrete versions and revisions, official acts and judicial decisions must be checked.

meaning_units.label: Foundation in the professional law
meaning_units.comment: The provision refers to the law which gives the National Council the task of preparing and updating the Code, binding on its members, subjecting it to referendums. Art. 42 is therefore a rule of temporal effectiveness, not a rule of clinical conduct.

in_practice: Identify the version of the Code relevant to the date of the conduct examined.
Verify proclamation, thirty-day term and subsequent acts on institutional sources.
Distinguish approved text, current text, proposal and text, possibly cancelled.
In flashcards and courses always indicate date and status of the studied version.
frequent_mistakes: Automatically make the vote closed and the results proclaimed.
Apply the revision from the very day of the proclamation.
Today, using a text only because it had obtained favourable votes, without checking its vigence.
Treat art. 42 as a daily disciplinary duty of the individual psychologist.

hypothetical_infringement.scenario: The results of a referendum on the Code are announced on March 1st. A manual states that the new text is already applicable on March 2 without checking other acts.
hypothetical_infringement.analysis: According to art. 42, the reference is the thirtyth day after the proclamation, not the next day. For a real case, calendar and official acts should also be checked. The scenario explains the temporal effectiveness, not an individual illicit.
